jobs.description:
Who we are

We’re a global, midsize CRO that pushes boundaries, innovates and invents because the path to a cure for the world’s most persistent diseases is not paved by those who play it safe. It is built by those who take pioneering, creative approaches and implement them with quality and excellence.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What you will do

The Investigator Grants Specialist is responsible for the development and dissemination of Investigator Grants (pre and post-award) while supporting various groups related to Investigator Grants delivery.

Reports directly to the Investigator Grants Manager.
Responsible for the development, delivery and maintenance of Investigator Grants exports during the bidding phase and during the template development phase of a study
Works closely with appropriate teams to ensure accurate, complete and timely deliveries of Investigator Grants.
Assists in the development and maintenance of processes, policies, SOPs and associated documents concerning Investigator Grants.
Liaises with the Investigator Grants team and advises Commercial Operations, Project Management, Business Development, Site Activation, Clinical Operations and Customers on forecasting strategies/risk mitigation surrounding Investigator Grants.
Review study protocols and liaise with competent departments as needed to complete a costing strategy for protocol-driven costs.
Review study budgets and costs pertaining to Investigator Grants operations and participate in Commercial Operations activities.

Perform other duties as assigned. The duties and responsibilities listed above are representative of the nature and level of work assigned and are not necessarily all-inclusive.

What you will bring to the role

Knowledge regarding global industry standard benchmarks, fair market value, and proven expertise using investigator grant software (i.e., GrantPlan, Grants Manager) on a global level.
Experience in reviewing and understanding study protocols, study budgets, as well as other technical, medical and legal documents related to Investigator Grants.
Ability to work in fast-paced, deadline oriented, and changing environment
Strong planning, strategizing, managing, monitoring, scheduling, critiquing and problem solving skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including negotiation skills and knowledge of clinical trial agreements to clearly and concisely present information.
Computer expertise with document and spreadsheet applications.

Your experience

Bachelor's degree or equivalent in business administration, law, science or related field.
Minimum of 2 years of experience in forecasting Investigator Grants.
Adept knowledge of biopharmaceutical/CRO industry and applicable local regulatory requirements.
Knowledge and understanding of global industry standard benchmarks, fair market value, ICH and GCP Guidelines, as well as local compensation and regulatory requirements.
Excellent spoken and written English language skills.
Prefer experience with investigator grant forecasting tools (i.e. GrantPlan, Grants Manager)

Promotion to the next level is not automatic based on years of experience. Personnel are evaluated on proven competency, level of responsibility, and ability to work independently.

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

To view our other roles, check out our careers page at Discover a world of difference at Worldwide! For more information on Worldwide, visit or connect with us on LinkedIn.

Worldwide is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed and, to that end, we prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and creativity. We know that when our employees feel appreciated and included, they can be more creative, innovative, and successful. jobs.title: Therapeutic Account Manager, Liver - Pittsburgh
jobs.excerpt: MISSIONMirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases.
jobs.description:
MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.

The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory Strategy & Business Performance

  • Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
  • Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
  • Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
  • Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.

Strategic Account Management & Network Development

  • Identify, prioritize, and develop high-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
  • Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
  • Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow-through.
  • Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
  • Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.

Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement

  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
  • Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
  • Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
  • Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.

Influence & Impact

  • Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
  • Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
  • Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries

Customer, Patient & Caregiver Impact

  • Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
  • Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
  • Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
  • Identify recurring customer, access, and patient-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Insights

  • Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, Analytics, and Advocacy.
  • Work seamlessly across field roles to coordinate account strategy, align priorities, clarify responsibilities, and ensure consistent follow-through while respecting functional boundaries.
  • Capture and communicate timely, objective, and actionable field insights that can inform strategy, messaging, training, resource development, customer experience, and execution priorities.
  • Contribute actively to business reviews, training programs, team meetings, launch readiness, and cross-functional initiatives; share best practices and support the success of the broader organization.

Entrepreneurial Drive, Resilience & Culture

  • Operate with a high degree of ownership, self-motivation, resourcefulness, and initiative in an unstructured, rapidly evolving rare disease environment.
  • Create appropriate engagement opportunities in underdeveloped accounts and markets, test new approaches, learn quickly, and translate insights into action.
  • Maintain sustained drive, discipline, and performance through pressure, uncertainty, obstacles, delays, and discouragement; recover quickly and remain focused on long-term goals.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning; actively seek feedback and apply coaching to strengthen clinical, strategic, and selling capabilities.
  • Model Mirum's values and the highest standards of ethical conduct, compliance, transparency, inclusion, and respect in every internal and external interaction.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of progressive sales experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently delivering business results in a complex specialty, rare disease, orphan drug, or high-science market.
  • Rare disease experience is highly preferred; experience in hepatology, gastroenterology, pediatric specialty care, or another complex specialty market is highly desirable.
  • Strong clinical aptitude and demonstrated ability to learn, retain, and communicate complex disease-state, diagnostic, mechanism-of-action, clinical-data, and product information.
  • Experience with account-based selling across health systems, centers of excellence, multidisciplinary care teams, referral networks, and influential healthcare professionals.
  • Demonstrated ability to use insight-led or challenger-style selling to constructively challenge the status quo, influence behavior, and advance customer decision-making.
  • Working knowledge of access and reimbursement dynamics, patient support pathways, and the role of patient services in rare disease markets.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to interpret performance data, identify insights, develop territory and account strategies, and translate plans into consistent field execution.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, communication, presentation, judgment, and ability to build trust with diverse and highly sophisticated customers.
  • Proven self-motivation, resourcefulness, resilience, organization, and ability to prioritize and perform independently in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
  • Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, and Analytics.
  • Commitment to ethical conduct, compliance, and approved promotional practices, with sound judgment in complex customer and patient-related situations.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel up to 70%, including frequent overnight travel and occasional weekend commitments.

jobs.excerpt: THE OPPORTUNITYJoin a team that’s changing financial services Zocks is the #1 AI assistant for financial advisors.
jobs.description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

Join a team that’s changing financial services

Zocks is the #1 AI assistant for financial advisors. We help advisors automate their operational work and grow their business. 5,000+ firms use Zocks to turn client conversations into completed work.

We're a venture-backed team, building something that changes how financial advisors serve their clients every day. Every role here is an opportunity to shape the product, the company, and the way an entire industry works. We hire sharp, curious, and kind people who want to do meaningful work and build something from the ground up, together.


WHO YOU ARE

The SHARC in the room

At Zocks, we hire for SHARC - five qualities that define how our best people work and win together.

S - Sharp

You move fast without cutting corners. Quick decisions, thoughtful execution - you know when to act independently and when to loop in leadership.

H - Hungry

You're a self-starter who celebrates teammates as loudly as your own wins. Humble hustle is your default mode.

A - Adaptable

Startup life means things shift fast. You lean into change, pivot gracefully, and genuinely enjoy figuring out what's next.

R - Resilient

Building something new isn't always smooth. You bounce back stronger, see obstacles as puzzles, and never lose sight of the bigger picture.

C - Curious

You ask the questions others miss. You explore for fun, not just for work - and it shows in the quality of your thinking.

About the Role

Zocks sells into compliance-sensitive financial services buyers - RIAs, IBDs, and wealth management firms - who put every vendor through security and compliance diligence before signing. Today, that diligence work falls on individual AEs, who complete VDDQs, RFPs, and RFIs themselves on top of their deal work, with no single owner, no shared knowledge base, and no visibility into how much it's costing the business in cycle time.

The Trust & Compliance Operations Manager owns this function end to end - the data room, the trust center, the VDDQ/RFP response process - turning diligence from a deal-blocking bottleneck reps absorb into a well-run, self-service function that shortens sales cycles and reinforces trust with our buyers, pre- and post-sale.

What You’ll Do

1. VDDQ, RFP, and RFI Ownership

  • Serve as the single point of accountability for every vendor due diligence questionnaire, RFP, and RFI that touches a deal - new business, renewal, or expansion.
  • Take response ownership off individual AEs entirely, running intake, drafting, internal review, and submission as a repeatable process.
  • Track every open request to a defined SLA and flag at-risk deals to Sales leadership before they slip.

2. Knowledge Base and Trust Center

  • Build and maintain a living knowledge base of pre-approved, audit-ready answers to recurring security, privacy, and compliance questions.
  • Keep that knowledge base current with each SOC 2 cycle, policy update, or material product/infrastructure change.
  • Partner with Engineering to scope and launch a self-service trust center when the knowledge base and process are mature enough to support it.

3. Data Room Management

  • Own the structure and upkeep of the due diligence data room - taxonomy, document versioning, access controls, and what's customer-facing versus internal.
  • Ensure every document in the room reflects the current state of Zocks' security and compliance posture, not a stale snapshot from the last deal.

4. Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Act as the connective tissue between Security, Legal, and Product on one side and Sales/CS on the other, so sales teams get accurate, current information without chasing multiple internal owners.
  • Build direct relationships with subject-matter owners in each function to keep source information flowing without manual chasing on every request.

5. Reporting and Commercial Impact

  • Define and publish an SLA for DDQ/RFP turnaround, and hold the function to it.
  • Report quarterly on deals unblocked or accelerated by the function, quantified in $ ARR, so leadership can see the direct commercial value of the work.

What We’re Looking For

Requirements

  • 4+ years experience owning VDDQs/RFPs/RFIs end to end, ideally in a regulated B2B SaaS environment
  • Working knowledge of security, privacy, and compliance frameworks relevant to financial-services vendors - SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, GLBA/Reg S-P, and SEC/FINRA vendor oversight expectations
  • Demonstrated ability to translate technical and legal detail into plain-English, customer-ready language under deadline pressure
  • Experience building repeatable process and structure (data room taxonomy, knowledge base, SLAs) rather than handling diligence as one-off firefighting
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with Security, Legal, Engineering, and Product to source accurate answers without deep technical expertise in each domain
  • Experience operating directly with prospects' and customers' security, compliance, and vendor-management teams, including on live diligence calls
  • Experience in or selling to financial services, wealthtech, or another regulated industry strongly preferred, given Zocks' focus on financial advisors and wealth management firms
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

LOGISTICS

  • This is a remote position, but we are currently only able to hire candidates who reside in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, CT, FL, GA, ID, IL, IA, KS, MA, MI, NE, NJ, NV, NY, NC, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, WA, WI
  • Background and reference checks required as part of onboarding

Interview process:

  • 30-min recruiter screen
  • Up to three 30-45-min video or onsite interviews
  • Offer pending references.

Total estimated time: ~3 hours

COMPENSATION

  • $150,000-$175,000 base salary
  • Equity - we're all building this together

BENEFITS

The full picture

Health

  • Medical: 100% of employee premium covered (UnitedHealthcare Select Plus network, 2 plan options)
  • Dental: 99% covered - Guardian, $1,500 annual benefit
  • Vision: 99% covered - Guardian/VSP, $150 frames & contacts allowance
  • FSA: Zocks matches dollar-for-dollar up to $500/year

Time off

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid sick time
  • 11 paid holidays

Family

  • Birthing parent: 12 weeks fully paid parental leave
  • Non-birthing parent: 6 weeks fully paid parental leave

Financial

  • 401(k) via Guideline - Pre-tax and Roth options; low-cost Vanguard funds

Everything else

  • MacBook laptop + Google Workspace, Slack, and Zoom provided
  • Equity grant - details included as part of your offer
  • Growth opportunities for high performers after 6 months
  • Collaborative, low-ego culture with smart, kind teammates

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

Zocks AI is an equal opportunity employer. We never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital, veteran, or disability status. We believe diversity drives creativity, innovation, and success - and we encourage all qualified people to apply.

We may use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process. These tools assist our team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are always made by humans.

jobs.description:
At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world-class programs and support every day.

Summary:

Senior Business Analysts are trusted partners to the business functions they serve. Their credibility as advisors

rests on expertise they actively build and apply: deep knowledge of CA’s organizational ecosystem, fluency in how

peers and the broader industry tackle the same challenges, and command of the functional discipline itself -- the

frameworks, standards, and emerging practices that define what good looks like. This combination is what allows

them to bring recommendations grounded in both CA’s context and a wider reference point. Sr. BAs shape how

problems are framed, not just how requirements are structured. They anticipate downstream impacts before

anyone asks. They are present in the operating rhythm of the business, not just the project lifecycle. Senior BAs

also invest in the broader BA team -- mentoring peers, raising the quality bar through their own work, and

contributing to the standards and methods that define how the function operates.

This Sr. BA role will serve as the trusted partner to the Marketing function, translating marketing process and system needs into clear, actionable IT requirements. Focus areas include marketing technology (martech) systems, data flows between marketing and CRM/CDP platforms, campaign and lead-management process design, and reporting/analytics infrastructure. The ideal candidate brings IT business analysis fundamentals — requirements gathering, systems thinking, SDLC/Agile delivery — plus enough marketing domain fluency to partner credibly with Marketing stakeholders, and works cross-functionally with Marketing, Sales Operations, and IT delivery teams to scope and deliver system and process improvements.

Essential Duties/Responsibilities:

Business Partnership & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to business within the assigned domain -- present and accessible in the

business’s operating rhythm, not just project ceremonies.

  • Build and maintain relationships with senior stakeholders; understand their priorities, constraints, and

context well enough to anticipate needs before they’re articulated.

  • Lead discovery for complex, multi-team initiatives; facilitate workshops and alignment sessions that

produce decisions, not just documentation.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment across competing priorities; resolve independently where possible, and

know when to bring in IT Business Partnering leadership or peer domain BAs to reach the right outcome.

  • Mentor peers on discovery, stakeholder engagement, and requirements quality; contribute patterns and

examples to the broader BA practice.

Requirements & Problem Definition

  • Shape and reframe problem statements; challenge assumptions and identify root causes that stakeholders

may not have fully surfaced.

  • Structure complex, ambiguous business needs into clear, actionable requirements for high-complexity

solutions -- with minimal rework from QA or development.

  • Anticipate downstream technical and business impacts; surface risks before they become blockers.
  • Connect individual initiative requirements to broader domain and organizational priorities -- visible in

every piece of work, not just strategic conversations.

Delivery Collaboration

  • Actively shape refinement and sprint planning across complex, multi-team initiatives.
  • Hold accountability for requirements quality across the full initiative; QA and UAT surface few surprises

attributable to gaps.

  • Lead UAT coordination: own coverage, quality, and completeness across multiple teams and workstreams. · Drive post-deployment validation and change management; track adoption, surface issues before they compound, and stay present until solutions are working as intended. Domain Knowledge & Documentation · Own the accuracy, currency, and depth of process maps and documentation across the entire assigned domain -- beyond individual project cycles. · Build and apply contextual experience within the assigned domain: understanding why current processes and rules exist, what’s been tried before and what happened, where the recurring pain points are, and how the domain has evolved. · Recognize patterns that come with domain experience -- downstream impacts that aren’t obvious without context, approaches that were tried and didn’t work, trends that signal where the domain is heading -- and use that recognition to sharpen requirements and surface risks early. Knowledge Engineering & AI Enablement · Own the domain-level knowledge base: business rules, process maps, and entity definitions structured for reuse by both human practitioners and AI tools. · Design multi-step AI-assisted workflows for domain-level tasks; define the sequencing, inputs, outputs, and validation checkpoints for each. · Set validation standards for the domain -- documented criteria for what ’good enough’ looks like for AI-assisted outputs on each class of task (stories, epics, test cases, etc.). · Build and maintain a domain-level agent-readiness map: which tasks are agent-assisted, which require human judgment, and why -- reviewed quarterly. · Conduct periodic agent accuracy reviews; diagnose systematic errors at the root cause -- missing context, rule gaps, prompt quality -- not just surface symptoms. Strategic Contribution · Proactively identify functional-level gaps and opportunities; bring recommendations with supporting rationale, not just observations. · Drive improvements to BA team standards, templates, and toolkits; identify gaps and propose enhancements to the practice. · Contribute to BA hiring, onboarding, and community of practice as an active participant and knowledge contributor.

Benefits and Pay Range:

Pay Range – This role’s range is $81,500 - $139,500. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that Curriculum Associates considers in making compensation decisions based on our Compensation Philosophy. Actual base pay within that range will vary based upon several factors including, but not limited to, prior experience and relevant skill sets. At Curriculum Associates, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances for each case. This role is also eligible to participate in the company bonus plan. The Company recognizes that minimum wage varies by location and will ensure all compensation decisions comply with applicable state and local laws.

Benefits – Benefit eligible employees (and their families) are covered by medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Employees can enroll in our company’s 401k plan and receive an employer match. Employees have access to a flexible vacation and sick policy in addition to twelve paid holidays and a winter office closure between Christmas and New Year's, as well as a number of additional perks and benefits.

Who are we?
We are a female-founded scale-up, currently made up of around 100 AltoVitians. Our fully-remote team hails from 26 different countries and collectively speaks 29 languages. Most of the time, it is our differences that are celebrated (whether they are in cultures, personalities, preferences or passions). However, despite those differences, there are a few principal attributes that we share which define an AltoVitian. AltoVitians are tenacious, humble, and thoughtful. Being humble is important because it enables us to keep learning every day, and tenacity is necessary because in a high performing environment as fast-paced as AltoVita, taking it slow is simply not an option!

Today is a particularly exciting time to join our team, we closed our Series A financing round in late 2022 and will be starting the Series B rounds in the coming year. This next chapter won’t always be a smooth ride, but it will be filled with innovation, excitement and opportunities, so if you are ready for the challenge (and the fun!) of growing with us, we would love to hear from you.

What we do

AltoVita is a multi-award winning accommodation platform that enables enterprises to consolidate accommodation programmes through the power of proprietary technology paired with a human centric approach.

AltoVita’s unique offering sets us apart in the market, providing a network of 10 million+ verified and vetted properties are all duty of care compliant, backed by a four-tier quality control process; located in over 35,000 cities & 165 countries world-wide. With our award-winning enterprise software and human-centric approach, we deliver smart and sustainable solutions to global talent mobility & business travel managers worldwide.

Our Client Development team plays a vital role as trusted advisors and partners to our clients. Embodying our consultative philosophy, this dedicated team proactively shares new market insights, analyzes data, and empowers our clients with the tools and knowledge to make informed decisions, ensuring our clients are always equipped to make the best choices for their corporate housing needs.

AltoVita’s technology provides a cloud-based bridge between the highly fragmented property distribution system and multinational Global 2000 companies. A proprietary two-way API integration with a standardised sourcing process reduces the legacy, inefficient 48-to-72-hour bidding process down to a few minutes, saving valuable time and money.

Corporate clients love the bespoke user interface seamlessly configured to their mobility policies, and employees enjoy a greater sense of choice and support in their relocation journey.

Key Responsibilities

Security and Privacy Operations

Support the day-to-day operation of AltoVita’s information security and privacy activities as well as the mindset transformation. One that scales as the business grows, earns the trust of partners and regulators, and reflects the values we hold around protecting the people we serve.

Responsibilities include:

  • Supporting the maintenance of security, privacy and compliance documentation.

  • Assisting with tracking security and privacy actions, control improvements and remediation activities.

  • Helping maintain registers such as risks, issues, actions, policies, vendors, assets, data processing activities and control evidence.

  • Coordinating updates between internal teams to ensure agreed actions are progressed.

  • Supporting the preparation of security and privacy reports, summaries and updates for internal stakeholders.

  • Helping ensure security and privacy activities are documented, repeatable and easy to evidence.

  • Escalating risks, issues or delays to the CISO or relevant business owner.

Compliance and Audit Support

Assist with internal and external compliance activities, including ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR and client assurance requirements.

Responsibilities include:

  • Supporting evidence gathering for audits, assessments and control reviews.

  • Helping maintain audit trackers, evidence folders and compliance records.

  • Coordinating with internal teams to obtain required documentation and control evidence.

  • Supporting follow-up actions from audits, assessments or client reviews.

  • Assisting with the maintenance of policies, procedures and standards.

  • Helping ensure compliance activities are well organised and delivered within agreed timelines.

  • Supporting the CISO and relevant control owners with audit preparation and remediation tracking.

Policy and Documentation Support

Help maintain clear, practical and accessible security and privacy documentation.

Responsibilities include:

  • Supporting the review and update of information security and privacy policies.

  • Assisting with the creation of standards, procedures, guidance notes and user-facing materials.

  • Helping ensure documents are version controlled, approved and communicated appropriately.

  • Maintaining policy review schedules and tracking required updates.

  • Drafting practical guidance for employees on security and privacy topics.

  • Supporting the communication of policy changes across the business.

  • Helping ensure documentation is accurate, consistent and aligned to business processes.

Security Awareness and Culture

Support the delivery of security and privacy awareness activities across AltoVita.

Responsibilities include:

  • Carry out security and privacy training administration and responsible for ensuring 100% completion rates across the business.

  • Supporting the development of awareness content, reminders, newsletters, FAQs and guidance.

  • Helping coordinate phishing simulations and follow-up communications.

  • Tracking training completion and awareness participation.

  • Supporting campaigns that promote secure behaviours and good privacy practices.

  • Helping make security and privacy feel practical, accessible and enabling.

  • Escalating recurring behavioural or process issues to the CISO or relevant business owner.

Privacy Support

Support AltoVita’s privacy activities under the direction of the relevant privacy, legal or security lead.

Responsibilities include:

  • Assisting with the maintenance of privacy records, including data processing registers and related documentation.

  • Supporting the tracking of privacy actions, assessments and improvement activities.

  • Helping gather information for privacy reviews, data mapping or data protection impact assessments.

  • Supporting internal teams with practical privacy guidance, escalating complex matters where needed.

  • Assisting with record keeping for data subject requests, incidents or privacy enquiries.

  • Helping ensure privacy documentation remains organised, accurate and accessible.

Client Assurance and Security Questionnaires

Support the completion of client security and privacy questionnaires, RFP responses and due diligence requests.

Responsibilities include:

  • Assisting with the preparation of responses to client security and privacy questions.

  • Maintaining a library of approved answers, evidence and supporting materials.

  • Coordinating with internal subject matter experts to obtain accurate information.

  • Ensuring responses are consistent with AltoVita’s current controls, policies and practices.

  • Helping translate technical or compliance information into clear, client-friendly language.

  • Tracking open client assurance requests and supporting timely completion.

  • Escalating complex, high-risk or contractual questions to the CISO, Legal or relevant business owner.

Supplier and Third-Party Support

Support supplier security and privacy processes under the direction of the CISO or relevant business owner.

Responsibilities include:

  • Assisting with supplier due diligence questionnaires and evidence collection.

  • Helping maintain supplier records, risk ratings and review schedules.

  • Tracking supplier security or privacy actions.

  • Supporting periodic reviews of key suppliers.

  • Helping ensure supplier documentation is complete and up to date.

  • Escalating potential supplier risks or concerns to the appropriate owner.

Incident and Risk Support

Support security, privacy and operational risk processes by helping with coordination, documentation and follow-up.

Responsibilities include:

  • Supporting the logging and tracking of security or privacy incidents.

  • Helping gather relevant information during incident reviews.

  • Maintaining incident notes, timelines and action trackers.

  • Supporting post-incident follow-up and lessons learned activities.

  • Assisting with risk register updates and remediation tracking.

  • Escalating suspected incidents or risks promptly to the CISO or relevant lead.

  • Supporting the documentation of controls, gaps and agreed improvements.

This role does not lead incident response or make final risk acceptance decisions.

IT and Access Control Support

Assist with security-related IT and access control activities where required.

Responsibilities include:

  • Day to day execution of access controls

  • Supporting access review processes by gathering user access information.

  • Helping track joiner, mover and leaver control activities.

  • Supporting evidence collection for account provisioning, deprovisioning and access approvals.

  • Assisting with documentation of access control processes.

  • Helping monitor completion of agreed access management actions.

  • Oversight and support on internal reviews of security tooling usage, adoption and documentation.

  • Escalating access control issues or gaps to IT, system owners or the CISO.

Profile

The successful candidate will be someone who:

  • Takes ownership of tasks and follows through.

  • Communicates clearly and professionally.

  • Can organise information, actions and evidence in a structured way.

  • Is comfortable working with different teams across the business.

  • Has strong attention to detail.

  • Can explain security and privacy topics in simple, practical terms.

  • Is curious and willing to learn.

  • Understands when to escalate issues.

  • Brings a pragmatic and positive approach.

  • Is comfortable operating in a fast-moving scale-up environment.

  • Wants to help build a strong security and privacy culture.

Essential Skills and Experience

What Success Looks Like

First 90 Days

jobs.title: Telehealth Dietitian Women's Health
jobs.excerpt: Simplex Health is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) to provide telehealth outpatient nutrition counseling in an integrative/functional nutrition setting.
jobs.description:
Simplex Health is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) to provide telehealth outpatient nutrition counseling in an integrative/functional nutrition setting. This is a PRN (as-needed) role requiring a minimum of 15 hours of weekly availability, with the opportunity to offer additional hours if desired. The ideal candidate has experience in clinical or outpatient nutrition counseling, is licensed (or eligible for licensure) in Pennsylvania, and is passionate about delivering personalized, root-cause care to support long-term health outcomes.

Our Mission: Radically improve the health of Humankind-one person, one appointment, one connection at a time.

At Simplex Health, we do things differently. Our insurance-funded medical nutrition therapy goes beyond symptom management to improve — and in many cases reverse — chronic conditions. We partner with hospitals, healthcare practices, and individuals to provide personalized, root-cause nutrition care across a wide range of conditions, including metabolic health, digestive disorders, hormonal imbalances, and chronic disease.

Our approach is grounded in prevention, root-cause resolution, and sustainable lifestyle change, supporting patients throughout their health journey. Through a fully virtual, telehealth model, we meet patients where they are, delivering accessible, high-quality care.

Our evidence-based, progressive nutrition interventions are tailored to each patient’s unique biochemistry. Through nutrition counseling, education, and health coaching, we empower patients to improve their health, build lasting habits, and achieve meaningful, long-term outcomes.

Role details:

  • Location: Telehealth
  • Schedule: PRN / flexible with consistent weekly availability
  • Reports to: Senior Clinical Director
  • Compensation: $55 to $60 hourly

You love helping women feel confident and supported during pregnancy, especially when navigating challenges like gestational diabetes. You just don’t love doing it all alone.

If you’ve ever run or dreamed of running your own private practice, you know what it takes. The marketing, the scheduling, the billing, the insurance headaches, the empty calendar days, the tech issues, and the isolation.

At Simplex Health, you get the best parts of private practice, including autonomy, flexibility, and deep one-on-one relationships with patients, without the burnout or business stress.

Here, you get to focus on what you do best: helping women through pregnancy, gestational diabetes (GDM), and hormone-related conditions using an integrative and functional nutrition approach.

What we are looking for:
We are seeking mission-driven dietitians (RD/RDN) who:

  • Are passionate about women’s health, pregnancy, and gestational diabetes (GDM)
  • Take an integrative and functional nutrition approach to care
  • Thrive in a collaborative, growth-minded environment
  • Have at least 2 years of experience in outpatient or clinical care
  • Have experience or strong interest in prenatal nutrition, GDM, or hormone-related conditions
  • Hold current registration with CDR
  • Minimum of 15 hours of weekly availability required, with flexibility and opportunity to increase hours over time based on your preferences and schedule
  • Are credentialed or open to being credentialed with insurance companies
  • Want to spend more time with patients and less time running a business
  • To avoid conflicts of interest, candidates should not maintain an active private practice or independent nutrition counseling business

Preferred:

  • Availability for evening appointments strongly preferred to meet patient demand, with flexibility based on individual scheduling needs.
  • CDCES (Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist) strongly preferred
  • IFNA Certified (IFNCP credential a plus); candidates actively enrolled in IFNA training welcome
  • Prior experience supporting pregnant patients or managing gestational diabetes

PA license and completion of major insurance credentialing required before start; this process may take 3–6 months.

Role Responsibilities (including but not limited to):

  • Provide telehealth medical nutrition therapy using a functional and integrative approach, with a primary focus on pregnancy and gestational diabetes (GDM)
  • Assess nutritional health of patients/clients with attention to prenatal needs, blood sugar regulation, and hormone-related conditions
  • Monitor and review daily blood glucose logs for GDM patients, providing timely feedback, adjustments, and ongoing support
  • Educate and train patients on proper use of glucose meters and blood sugar monitoring techniques
  • Develop and modify individualized nutrition care plans, with a focus on glycemic control during pregnancy
  • Coordinate care and communicate effectively with referring physicians and healthcare providers to ensure continuity of care
  • Implement Simplex Health protocols and materials in patient care
  • Document all new and follow-up appointments in the Healthie platform with strong attention to detail
  • Respond to all patient communications in a timely and supportive manner
  • Communicate openly and effectively to resolve work-related issues or conflicts
  • Proactively contribute to team collaboration and support team decisions and outcomes
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures
  • Stay current and forward-thinking with emerging research in women’s health, prenatal nutrition, and diabetes care
  • Manage a full and consistent patient caseload, ensuring timely follow-ups, continuity of care, and optimal patient outcomes
  • Maintain a minimum of 15 hours of weekly availability, with opportunity to grow into a higher-hour or full-time schedule

What to expect:

At Simplex Health, you’ll have access to:

  • Structured onboarding and training
  • Regular case reviews and clinical collaboration
  • Real-time support via team chat and peer connection
  • Team meetings and shared learning opportunities
  • Opportunities to contribute to committees, resources, and clinical initiatives
  • Credentialing: If you’re not yet in-network, our team fully manages the insurance credentialing process on your behalf, including covering all associated fees and handling the paperwork.
  • Ramp-Up To Full-Time: This role begins in a ramp-up phase with variable hours as your patient caseload grows, transitioning into a full-time, salaried schedule once full-time metrics are met. Our team provides consistent referrals and support to help you build a full and sustainable schedule as quickly as possible.

Benefits

  • Flexible Scheduling: Set your availability with the ability to build and adjust your schedule based on your preferences and patient demand
  • Supplement Commissions: Earn 12.5% of MSRP on supplements purchased through Fullscript, providing additional earning potential.
  • Performance-Based Bonus Opportunities: Earn additional income based on patient retention and face-to-face care time.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO): Accrue 1 hour of PTO for every 12 hours of patient care, supporting flexibility and time away as you work.
  • Discretionary Holiday Break: Office closed between Christmas and New Year’s
  • Fitness Allowance: Partial reimbursement for gym memberships, fitness classes, or wellness activities
  • Simplex Wellness on Demand: Free access to virtual fitness programs

Key Intangible Characteristics of the Ideal Candidate:

Called: A passion for our mission and a sense that this role and company are a strong fit for the blessings of your gifts, talents, passions, and experiences.. Must be mission-motivated with a resolve to overcome obstacles, anchored in a sense of purpose in this work.

Servant Leadership: Nobody is above any task, and we are all here to serve others. Every customer—internal or external—needs help, and the most powerful way to lead will be to serve.

Learning and Adaptive: As a startup with a big mission, new systems, technology, and situational adaptability are expected. This person must have an appetite for learning and skill improvement.

Grit, Resourcefulness & Entrepreneurial Spirit: Not everything will have a pre-planned solution. This person will have to be resourceful in figuring things out, resist feeling overwhelmed, and be willing to roll up their sleeves to make things happen. This person will have to have an open mind and good resolve, whether it’s looping in other people, finding answers online, or seeking best practices.

Organizational Skills: Being or becoming a constant organizational force. It will require a capacity for being open to change, discerning better processes, and prioritizing for improved outcomes.

Chemistry Fit: We have a unique and fun culture—we laugh, press in, work hard, and jump in to figure things out. Fitting into the team chemistry is essential.

High Character: We operate with a high trust culture. Personal values must fuel our work. Integrity, honesty, compassion, reconciliation, and diligence are all things this person must possess to flourish.

Energy & Enthusiasm: This person must bring joy and passion for work to the job. Encouraging and spurring on others on the mission while being self-motivated and positive is essential.

Multitasking: This is not a steady-state or static environment. Workflow will cycle, and interruptions are normal, so this person must be able to juggle and adjust on the fly.

Project Management: While multitasking, this person must be able to keep an eye on deadlines and critical dependencies, working to preserve them or source support proactively.

🌟 Why Dietitians Choose Simplex Health

Because great clinicians deserve great support.

🧾 We Handle Credentialing & Licensing
We cover insurance credentialing costs and reimburse for out-of-state license fees.

🎓 CEU Reimbursement
We invest in your professional growth and continued learning.

💻 Technology Reimbursement
Support for the tools you need to work efficiently and effectively.

💲 Recruitment Thank You Bonus
Bonus for any referrals hired by Simplex Health who stay at least 90 days

📋 Consistent Referrals & Quality Resources
A steady patient flow and high-quality patient-facing materials to support your care.

👥 Helpful Support Team & Quick Response Times
From scheduling to tech help, our support staff makes your day run smoother.

🌿 Approachable Leadership & Collaborative Culture
Leaders who listen, and a clinical community that truly supports one another.

🤝 Opportunities Beyond Patient Care
Get involved with social media, engagement projects, or hosting lunch & learns.

🌎 Broad Range of Clients, Deep Skill Development
Grow your counseling skills and confidence across a variety of cases.

💞 Strong Sense of Community
Even in a virtual environment, you’ll feel connected, encouraged, and supported.

If you’ve ever wished you could combine the freedom of private practice with the camaraderie and stability of a larger organization, this is where you belong.

Apply today and rediscover the joy of patient care without the grind of running a business.

Simplex Health Core Values:

Simplex Health strives to embody the following values and to apply them to every aspect of how we run our business, including how we interact with each other as teammates and leaders. These values also apply to how we interact with and continue to inspire our clients and strategic partners:

We Inspire Each Other
You are an important part of our team and together we make a collective intention to uplift and commit to one another. Through cultivating genuine, transparent, relationships, we create an environment that encourages individuals to dream big, take risks, and be bold. We aim to inspire and commit to everyone we touch. This sense of commitment and care sets the stage for a culture of accountability, where we hold ourselves and each other to the same high standards, taking the ownership necessary for achieving our goals.
Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.
1 Thessalonians 5:11

We Always Learn and Grow
We at Simplex Health strive to be continual learners and to expand our abilities as people and as an organization. We educate ourselves, remain curious, and use evidence-based research to challenge our current understanding. We see mistakes and failure as great teachers and learning opportunities. When we stay engaged in the world with a growth mindset, it creates the right environment for us to thrive and make a meaningful impact on each other and on the world.
Let the wise hear and increase in learning, and the one who understands obtain guidance.
Proverbs 1:5

We Think Big Picture What we do day in, day out, how we do it, and the decisions we make- shape who we are as a people and as a company. The details are super important, AND should always be guided by our wide perspective and an understanding of how we are impacting each other, our clients, and our business. Before making any major decision, ask yourself:

• Does it help us grow? How?

• Does it answer “how are we different and why should you care?”
• Is what I’m working on duplicatable and transferable (ie can I duplicate it and apply to other situations)? How?
• Does it challenge the status quo?
• Does it inspire?
• Does it tightly align with and advance our mission? How?
• Can it be more humanized and relatable?
• Does it unite us? How?
• Does it solve a problem? How?
Now we see things imperfectly, like puzzling reflections in a mirror, but then we will see everything with perfect clarity. All that I know now is partial and incomplete, but then I will know everything completely, just as God now knows me completely.
I Corinthians 13:12

We Challenge the Status Quo:
We are inquisitive by nature. We are courageous! We are not afraid to go against the grain in our search for truth. We always question conventional wisdom- it’s how Simplex Health started- it’s what we do.
Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will. Romans 12:2

We Cultivate Health and Vitality:
Being alive in a body is an incredible, temporary experience. Even though at times we feel pain and face challenges, our next breath is not guaranteed and is a HUGE gift. We experience EVERYTHING through our bodies, including thoughts, emotions, spirit, and our inspiration. We see health and vitality as the foundation for living a life that is happy, fulfilled, present, and productive.
Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.
3 John 1:2

We Embody Integrity:
We communicate with transparency and face conflict head-on. We do this with the understanding that we respect each other and recognize that we are on the same team working toward a unified noble mission with shared goals. We don’t compromise our morals or integrity no matter the context. When challenging scenarios arise, we approach them with honesty and trust that we are all holding the highest intentions, are committed to our values, and are making best efforts.
Do to others as you would have them do to you.
Luke 6:31

We Simplify the Complicated:
We believe that complex problems don’t always require complex solutions. By simplifying the complicated and offering digestible, scalable solutions, we can pay more attention to the things that matter most. Simplicity- it’s the word that inspired our name - we make cultivating health and vitality simple.
Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God.
Philippians 4:6

jobs.title: Staff Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About FullscriptWe’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better.
jobs.description:
About Fullscript

We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. Make it easier for practitioners to access the products they trust so they can deliver better care.

That simple idea grew into a platform that powers every part of care. Today, more than 125,000 practitioners use Fullscript for clinical insights, lab interpretations, patient analytics, education, and access to high-quality supplements. Over 10 million patients rely on Fullscript to stay connected to their care plans and follow through on treatment.

We build tools that make care smarter and more human. Tools that save time, simplify decisions, and help practitioners stay closely connected to the people they care for. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better.

This is your invitation.

Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people.
Join us and shape the future of care.

The Opportunity

Team GSD is Fullscript’s internal AI and automation team. We build the shared infrastructure, integrations, and internal tools that help Fullscripters improve how work gets done across the company. We’re looking for a Staff Developer to help shape and build the technical foundation behind that work.

Our work starts with real business problems. We use AI and modern automation to reduce manual effort, connect fragmented workflows, and give teams practical tools they can rely on in production. We care about speed, but we also care about building systems that are secure, observable, maintainable, and able to scale.

This is a deeply hands-on individual contributor role focused on internal products and infrastructure rather than Fullscript’s customer-facing platform. You will design and operate production systems that connect large language models with company data, tools, and workflows through technologies such as MCP, agentic systems, model gateways, and workflow orchestration.

You will work with a high degree of autonomy. Direction and business context will come from the GSD team and targeted conversations with business owners, but you will be expected to define the technical path, challenge assumptions, make pragmatic trade-offs, and carry meaningful work from an ambiguous problem through production. This is not a ticket-driven role.

At the Staff level, your impact will extend beyond the systems you personally build. You will help determine what GSD should tackle next, influence architectural decisions, act as a thought partner to other experienced developers, and raise the team’s technical capability through reviews, pairing, documentation, office hours, and engineering discussions.

This is how we like building software:. If you share our values, we’d be excited to talk with you.

What you'll do

  • Architect and build production-grade internal AI tools and shared platform capabilities used by teams across Fullscript.

  • Lead the technical design and delivery of complex AI integrations, including MCP-based tool use, agentic workflows, context layers, model gateways, and workflow automation.

  • Independently take ambiguous business problems from technical discovery and architecture through implementation, deployment, measurement, and ongoing operation.

  • Develop and maintain the infrastructure that connects approved models with Fullscript’s internal systems, data, APIs, and user workflows.

  • Own the reliability, scalability, observability, and security of production AI systems, including model routing, evaluation, access control, and the responsible handling of sensitive data.

  • Build internal experiences that are useful to people across the business, contributing across backend services, infrastructure, and user-facing interfaces where the problem requires it.

  • Work with GSD teammates, engineers, and business owners to understand high-value workflows and translate them into maintainable technical solutions without becoming dependent on heavy stakeholder oversight.

  • Evaluate emerging AI models, frameworks, and patterns through practical experimentation, then make clear recommendations about what Fullscript should adopt, adapt, or avoid.

  • Shape GSD’s technical roadmap by identifying reusable platform opportunities, challenging architectural assumptions, and connecting engineering investments to measurable business impact.

  • Act as a force multiplier through thoughtful code reviews, pairing, technical guidance, documentation, office hours, and active participation in the broader engineering community.

What you bring to the table

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience, including demonstrated impact as a technical leader on complex production systems.

  • Hands-on experience building and operating AI-enabled applications in production, including strong familiarity with MCP or comparable tool-use protocols, agents, context management, and LLM integrations.

  • A track record of building internal tools, developer platforms, or enterprise systems that were adopted by real users and produced measurable operational impact.

  • Deep backend engineering expertise in Ruby, Python, or a comparable language, along with the ability to learn new languages and frameworks as the problem requires.

  • Strong systems-design fundamentals, including APIs, integrations, distributed systems, data flows, authentication, authorization, and pragmatic architectural trade-offs.

  • Practical cloud and DevOps experience operating reliable systems in AWS or a comparable environment, including CI/CD, containers, serverless infrastructure, observability, and infrastructure as code.

  • The ability to work independently through ambiguity, define your own path forward, and drive substantial initiatives to completion without waiting for detailed requirements or a queue of tickets.

  • Clear, credible communication and Staff-level influence, with the ability to explain decisions, challenge other experienced engineers constructively, share knowledge, and connect technical work to business outcomes.

Bonus if you have

  • Experience with React, TypeScript, or GraphQL and the ability to contribute to full-stack internal applications.

  • Experience with n8n, Temporal, or another workflow orchestration platform.

  • Familiarity with LLM evaluation and observability platforms such as Langfuse.

  • Experience with GitLab CI/CD, Kubernetes, Cloudflare Workers, or similar infrastructure and deployment tooling.

  • Experience building technology in healthcare or another regulated environment governed by standards such as HIPAA or SOC 2.

Technical Envionrment

  • Languages and frameworks: Ruby, React, TypeScript, Python, GraphQL, and SQL
  • AI and LLM: Multiple LLM providers, AWS Bedrock, AI gateway, MCP, agentic workflows, and AI evaluation and observability tooling
  • Infrastructure: AWS, EKS/Kubernetes, GitLab CI/CD, Cloudflare, serverless services, and infrastructure as code
  • Data: Snowflake and PostgreSQL
  • Observability: Langfuse, Sentry, and Coralogix

What we can offer you

  • Remote-first flexibility to work where you work best, with Ottawa, Toronto, or Calgary preferred for this role.

  • Flexible PTO and competitive pay, because work-life balance matters

  • RRSP/401k match and competitive compensation packages to invest in your future

  • Premium benefits package with customizable coverage, paramedical services, and an HSA.

  • Fullscript discounts to save on high-quality wellness products

  • Continuous learning opportunities to grow your skills and career

Compensation range

The salary range for this role is between $170,000 and $190,000 (CAD). Fullscript shares salary ranges to support transparency and help candidates make informed decisions. The range shown reflects base salary only. The range shown reflects base salary only. Additional incentives, perks, and benefits may be available as part of Fullscript’s total rewards package.

Final compensation depends on experience, skills, and location. We review pay regularly to stay aligned with market data and internal equity. Benefits and total rewards may vary by region.

Why Fullscript

Great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and inspired. At Fullscript, we stay curious and keep finding smarter ways to make care better. We grow together, take on new challenges, and focus on impact. We put people first, work as a team, and leave egos at the door.

What to Know Before You Apply

We’re grateful for the interest in joining Fullscript. To make sure your application reaches our hiring team, please apply directly through our careers page.

A quick note: Due to the high volume of applications, we’re not able to respond to phone or email inquiries about application status. If there’s a match, our team will reach out directly.

Fullscript is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive workplace. Accommodations are available upon request at .

All offers are contingent on successful background checks conducted in compliance with federal, state, and provincial laws.

We use AI tools to support parts of the hiring process, including screening and reviewing responses. Final hiring decisions are always made by people and follow all applicable privacy and employment laws in Canada and the U.S.

In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

Parsons is looking for a talented Project Controls Specialist to join our team!In this role you will support transparent tracking of cost, schedule, progress, productivity, risk, contingency, and performance metrics across selected projects.

​

What Required Skills You’ll Bring

jobs.description:
Who we are
We are a female-founded scale-up, currently made up of around 100 AltoVitians. Our fully-remote team hails from 26 different countries and collectively speaks 29 languages. Most of the time, it is our differences that are celebrated (whether they are in cultures, personalities, preferences or passions). However, despite those differences, there are a few principal attributes that we share which define an AltoVitian. AltoVitians are tenacious, humble, and thoughtful. Being humble is important because it enables us to keep learning every day, and tenacity is necessary because in a high performing environment as fast-paced as AltoVita, taking it slow is simply not an option!

Today is a particularly exciting time to join our team, we closed our Series A financing round in late 2022 and will be starting the Series B rounds in the coming year. This next chapter won’t always be a smooth ride, but it will be filled with innovation, excitement and opportunities, so if you are ready for the challenge (and the fun!) of growing with us, we would love to hear from you.

What we do

AltoVita is a multi-award winning accommodation platform that enables enterprises to consolidate accommodation programmes through the power of proprietary technology paired with a human centric approach.

AltoVita’s unique offering sets us apart in the market, providing a network of 10 million+ verified and vetted properties are all duty of care compliant, backed by a four-tier quality control process; located in over 35,000 cities & 165 countries world-wide. With our award-winning enterprise software and human-centric approach, we deliver smart and sustainable solutions to global talent mobility & business travel managers worldwide.

Our Client Development team plays a vital role as trusted advisors and partners to our clients. Embodying our consultative philosophy, this dedicated team proactively shares new market insights, analyzes data, and empowers our clients with the tools and knowledge to make informed decisions, ensuring our clients are always equipped to make the best choices for their corporate housing needs.

AltoVita’s technology provides a cloud-based bridge between the highly fragmented property distribution system and multinational Global 2000 companies. A proprietary two-way API integration with a standardised sourcing process reduces the legacy, inefficient 48-to-72-hour bidding process down to a few minutes, saving valuable time and money.

Corporate clients love the bespoke user interface seamlessly configured to their mobility policies, and employees enjoy a greater sense of choice and support in their relocation journey.

Role Description

Client Development & Interaction

  • Deliver executive-level strategic account management, acting as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders within the client organisation.

  • Design and lead consultative engagements focused on technology adoption, cost optimisation, workflow efficiency, and experience improvement.

  • Drive high client satisfaction, measured through proprietary evaluations, NPS scores, and qualitative feedback from key stakeholders.

  • Represent AltoVita at industry events and senior client forums across the Americas.

  • Present supply chain performance, cost analysis, and strategic recommendations at monthly reviews and QBR sessions.

  • Lead the design and implementation (project management) of Accommodation solutions tailored to the client's evolving programme requirements (Preferred Supply Chain, Technology Co-Design, Geographic Coverage, multi-level Employee Strategy etc.).

  • Champion the client's full adoption of AltoVita's technology and product suite.

  • Maintain proactive, transparent, and solutions-oriented communication with clients at all times, particularly during critical issues, escalations, or service-impacting events.

  • Ensure all client communications regarding timelines, deliverables, incidents, and resolutions are strictly aligned with contractual SLA commitments and internal operational standards.

  • Demonstrate strong executive presence and responsiveness, especially in high-pressure situations, ensuring clients feel informed, prioritized, and confidently managed.

  • Drive internal cross-functional alignment to ensure commitments communicated externally are realistic, achievable, and consistently delivered (Sales, Product, Hospitality Growth, Customer Success, Finance).

  • Consistent and proactive communication is a core requirement of this role. All stakeholders, including clients, partners, leadership, and cross-functional teams, are expected to receive timely updates, clear ownership, and responsive follow-through at all times.

Strategic Client Ownership & Supply Chain Management

  • Own and lead the end-to-end relationship with a designated key corporate client(s), serving as their primary executive point of contact across all strategic and operational matters.

  • Co-lead strategy client's accommodation supply chain strategy, including partnering, and expanding the supplier network to ensure consistent quality, coverage, and competitiveness across the US.

  • Lead the negotiation, execution, and ongoing management of Master Lease Agreements (MLAs), including renewals, amendments, and compliance oversight.

  • Develop a deep understanding of the client's global mobility programme, workforce profile, and accommodation needs to anticipate demand and shape supply strategy accordingly.

Supply Chain Growth & Commercial Leadership

  • Identify gaps in supply coverage and proactively build out the supplier portfolio in priority markets.

  • Manage supplier relationships at a senior level, ensuring performance, compliance, and strategic alignment.

  • Work cross-functionally with AltoVita's supply, product, and operations teams to deliver an integrated and scalable supply chain.

  • Track and report on supply chain KPIs, occupancy trends, cost benchmarks, and MLA utilisation.

Requirements

  • Minimum 10+ years of experience in corporate housing, global mobility or relocation is a must.

  • Significant and proven experience managing direct corporate accounts and enterprise-level clients. Demonstrated ability to own and grow strategic client relationships at executive and stakeholder level, including mobility leadership (direct) engagement

  • Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to influence internally and externally across multiple seniority levels.

  • Commercially minded with strong analytical and strategic thinking capabilities, including solution design, revenue retention, upsell identification, and risk mitigation.

  • Demonstrated experience negotiating and managing Master Lease Agreements or similar long term accommodation contracts.

  • Proven track record in the corporate accommodation industry (serviced apartments, hospitality, corporate agency, corporate housing among others)

  • Commercially astute, with the ability to translate client needs into supply strategy and accommodation providers

  • Fast learner, problem solver.

  • Frequent travel is required for this position.

Ways of Working

AltoVita is a fully remote team. Although we have regular touch-points throughout the week, organise off-sites in several locations, trust is essential for us to work effectively as a team. Our founders empower us to make decisions autonomously, and in turn expect that we also empower our direct reports.

Join our Team

AltoVita is the sum of every member of the team. We know that a strong team is a diverse team, and are therefore committed to being an equal opportunity employer, so please bring all of yourself to the interviews and most importantly to our team.

Becoming an AltoVitian means you will benefit from:

  • A team that will always put you first

  • Incredible opportunities for growth and career advancement

jobs.excerpt: Product engineering at Descript means owning outcomes, not just tickets — you'll take a problem from a rough idea to a shipped, measured result, working closely with product, design, and the rest of engineering along the way.
jobs.description:
Product engineering at Descript means owning outcomes, not just tickets — you'll take a problem from a rough idea to a shipped, measured result, working closely with product, design, and the rest of engineering along the way. We organize around a few teams, each responsible for a distinct part of the product:

  • Editor: owns our video editor. Help make traditionally complex video-editing workflows simpler, craft cutting-edge AI into practical creative tools, and build on our vision of turning a text-editor for video into a tool that puts video in everyone's communication toolkit.
  • Growth & Monetization: owns onboarding and activation, growth loops and in-product experiments, plans and pricing, checkout, billing, and AI credits. Help turn visitors into customers and customers into revenue.
  • Media: owns project and media management (plus importing, managing, manipulating, compositing, transitions, shaders, visual and audio effects, rendering, exporting, and more!).
  • AI: owns our agentic co-editor, Underlord, and the external API that allows it to scale. Help improve Underlord's harness to enhance its powers, polish its UX and editor integration, and add more capability to our API to unleash Underlord on the world.

Regardless of your team you’ll have the opportunity to design thoughtful full-stack systems that work reliably and deliver value to new and existing users.

What You’ll Own

  • Own meaningful product surfaces end to end. Take problems from definition through design, implementation, launch, measurement, and maintenance. Improve core Editor workflows, shape the self-serve journey from signup through renewal, or help make Underlord more sentient.
  • Shape the product, not just the implementation. Partner with Product and Design to propose better interactions, expose constraints, choose the right metrics, and find simpler paths to user outcomes.
  • Build ambitious full-stack systems with care. Create responsive, reliable experiences. Stretch from TypeScript and React to NodeJS and Temporal to first and third party integrations to get the job done.
  • Improve how the team learns and ships. Form hypotheses, instrument your work, release incrementally, and read results honestly. Strengthen the tooling, standards, tests, observability, and release practices that help the team move quickly without compromising quality.
  • Raise the team’s technical ambition. Provide architectural direction, thoughtful reviews, mentoring, and clear human writing.

What You Bring

Required:

  • You have 5+ years of experience building and shipping customer-facing products, including end-to-end features that measurably improved user or business outcomes.
  • You effectively leverage agents to multiply your impact and think critically about how to better harness AI in your work.
  • You’ve owned features/experiments end to end, from planning through launch, and leveraged analytics and metrics to evaluate impact.
  • You orient quickly in unfamiliar systems by exploring and asking thoughtful questions to both your teammates and agents.
  • You care about how software feels and notice when the technically correct result is still wrong for the user.
  • You create clarity in ambiguous work and can navigate (and simplify!) significant product and technical complexity.
  • You validate your work rigorously through focused reproductions, logs, tests, and other evidence rather than trusting that the output looks right.

Experience that helps:

  • Similar Products: Work on an editor, media product, creative tool, or payment system (like Stripe).
  • Our Stack: TypeScript, HTML/CSS, React, Redux, Node.js, API design, Temporal Workflows, and SQL. But we obviously live in a post stack world. We just rewrote our media engine in Rust. None of us knows Rust.
  • Crafting with AI: Building an agent or experimenting with media-generation models.
  • Experimentation/Analytics Experience: We like people who know how to measure their success through experimentation and product analytics.
  • Intricacies of Video: Shaders, graphics rendering, audio/visual effects, and media formats.

Descript is a startup. We're especially interested in working with engineers who use the product and are aligned with our mission. To that end, we promise to review any application that includes a share link to a Descript video. The video can be about anything - your career, a favorite game or movie, a discarded audition tape for Love Island. If you take the time to make something in Descript, we'll commit to having a human watch it and review your application. 🤝

Compensation and benefits

Base salary range: $220,000-$265,000, plus equity and benefits. Final offer amounts will carefully consider multiple factors, including prior experience, expertise, location, and level, and may vary from the amount above.
