Sobre a

Conheça nossa visão nas palavras doRonaldo, fundador e líder da empresa:

[Clique para acessar o vídeo]

AGIRO.TECHé uma fintech que atua como uma plataforma de originação e distribuição de crédito para correspondentes bancários, combinando tecnologia de ponta e inteligência de mercado. Somos resolvedores de problemas complexos e o nosso combustível são os desafios trazidos por nossos parceiros. Com nossa expertise de negócios, simplificamos a jornada de crédito e habilitamos novas receitas financeiras para que empresas e varejistas ofereçam crédito de forma eficiente.

Aqui todos precisam ter o conhecimento dos instrumentos que viabilizam essa engrenagem. Portanto, prepare-se para aprender a fundo como funcionam FIDCs, Securitizadoras e soluções tecnológicas para a originação e distribuição de crédito.

Nossas soluções são integradas e invisíveis: por meio de APIs robustas, nossos parceiros acoplam nossa tecnologia de intermediação diretamente nos serviços que já prestam. É aí que reside um dos nossos maiores desafios: cada parceiro possui um ambiente de sistemas diferente, com cenários técnicos particulares. Cada desafio é único, e temos enorme satisfação em arquitetar e desenvolver a solução de integração ideal.

Como pensamos (Nosso DNA)

Valorizamos quem temBRIO!

Somos uma empresa formada por NERDS apaixonados por resolver problemas complexos do mercado financeiro. Atuamos com umamentalidade de jogo infinito: não focamos em ganhar uma partida isolada, mas em permanecer no jogo, buscando desafios cada vez maiores e manter um aprendizado contínuo para ser cada dia melhor.

Na GIRO.TECH temos um ambiente realmente meritocrático, quem entrega e colabora mais, será sempre recompensado. Nosso time sênior e lideranças é majoritariamente formado por pessoas que entraram na empresa em cargos Júnior e até mesmo como estagiários. Aqui, novas vagas importantes são prioritariamente preenchidas com pessoas da casa.

Nossos processos seletivos são uma busca de futuros sócios da empresa. Para ir rápido, melhor ir sozinho. Se queremos construir algo grande, precisamos nos juntar a mais gente boa que pense como a gente. Dedicamos muito tempo nos processos seletivos para achar essas pessoas e entregamos desafios constantes para promover crescimento. Temos hoje comosócios da empresa, muitas pessoas que começaram em posições de base e mostraram que têm vontade de ser mais.

Fundadores - nossa base

Uma empresa é a extensão dos valores e sonhos de seus sócios fundadores. A GIRO.TECH foi fundada por quatro sócios, que têm como primeira formação a tecnologia, e são apaixonados por servir os outros usando seu conhecimento e por resolver problemas complexos.


Isso é GIRO.TECH

  • Liderança e Mentoria:aqui não temos "chefes", mas líderes que caminham lado a lado, incentivam e ensinam.
  • Voz Ativa:a melhor ideia prevalece, não o maior cargo. Oferecemos espaço para testar, errar e aprender.
  • Liberdade e Responsabilidade:valorizamos o trabalho remoto e a autonomia. Você tem liberdade para trabalhar de onde preferir e vestir o que for mais confortável; em troca, esperamos responsabilidade total com as entregas.
  • Crescimento Interno:priorizamos nosso time para ocupar novas vagas e posições mais desafiadoras. Temos muitas pessoas que iniciaram como estagiários e hoje evoluíram para o nível sênior, alguns, inclusive, passaram a ser sócios da empresa.
  • Excelência Técnica:nossa principal estratégia comercial é possuir a melhor tecnologia e um produto de alta performance. O resultado é a satisfação dos nossos clientes, que nos avaliam constantemente com notas acima de 9.

Isso NÃO é GIRO.TECH

  • Não somos uma instituição financeira tradicional de "terno e colete puffer".
  • Não valorizamos hierarquias rígidas ou burocracias excessivas para tomada de decisão.
  • Não somos os donos da verdade; somosinquietos, curiosos e abertos a mudanças.

Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos pessoas capazes de se adaptar a cenários dinâmicos e com sede de conhecimento. Valorizamos ainquietude: a busca constante por evoluir processos e construir resultados melhores a cada dia.

Se você é apaixonado por solucionar problemas com excelência, busca desafios que te tirem da zona de conforto e nunca está satisfeito com o mediano, seu lugar é aqui.

Vem construir o futuro da tecnologia de crédito com a gente!



Sobre a vaga:

Estamos em busca de um(a)estagiário(a) contábil-financeiro. NaGIRO.TECH, a contabilidade não é apenas burocracia; é a base de dados que sustenta nossas operações complexas de crédito.

﻿Se você é um "nerd dos números", apaixonado por entender como demonstrações contábeis refletem a saúde de uma operação financeira e possui umamentalidade de jogo infinito, queremos você no nosso time para nos ajudar a manter a fluidez e a precisão da nossa infraestrutura.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Nesta cadeira, você será responsável por garantir que a engrenagem financeira gire sem atritos. Suas principais missões serão:

  • Oferecer um excelente atendimento aos nossos clientes;
  • Oferecer um atendimento consultivo e resolutivo aos nossos clientes, sanando dúvidas e mediando conflitos com parceiros e fornecedores.
  • Realizar a importação de operações de crédito no sistema e gerir a venda desses ativos para os fundos vinculados;

  • Como estamos em constante mudança e crescimento, esperamos que você se adapte rapidamente a novos cenários e ajude a evoluir nossos processos internos, propondo melhorias para ganhar eficiência.

  • Organização e Adaptabilidade:A essência da nossa operação é o processo. Procuramos um perfil que valorize a rotina e a estabilidade das tarefas diárias, executando-as com excelência. É fundamental ter sede de conhecimento para entender o "porquê" de cada etapa e poder identificar oportunidades de melhoria, mantendo a flexibilidade para se adaptar a mudanças de cenário quando necessário.

About Us

Are you ready to build the future of the supply chain? At Gather AI, we’re not just creating software; we’re pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We’ve developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining “on-time, in full” delivery.

If you’re looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We’re leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.

About the Team

This role work closely with a Senior Machine Learning Scientist and our Lead Machine Learning Infrastructure Engineer, alongside cross-functional partners in Cloud Engineering, Product, and Operations. The role spans both deep technical work and collaboration with teams closest to the customer. As a Principal-level IC, you'll have real input into technical direction — not just executing on decisions, but helping make them.

About the Role

We are looking for a Principal Machine Learning Scientist to advance the state of our computer vision systems for warehouse inventory scanning. You will work across the full ML lifecycle — from research and model architecture through training, deployment, and production monitoring — with a focus on delivering measurable improvements to detection, segmentation, and OCR accuracy across our drone and MHE Vision products.

This role is ideal for a senior ML practitioner who wants principal-level impact on a core product, a variety of deployment targets (cloud, on-prem, embedded), and real-world data with tangible business outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Advance core computer vision model performance (object detection, segmentation, OCR) for warehouse inventory scanning across drone and MHE Vision platforms
  • Own the full ML lifecycle from research and experiment design through production deployment and monitoring — applying rigorous ablation studies and SOTA methodology
  • Collaborate with the ML infrastructure team on model optimization and deployment across cloud and edge inference targets (ONNX, TensorRT, quantization)
  • Work with Operations and Product to understand customer needs and translate them into ML improvements with measurable business impact
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to the ML team, raising standards for experiment design, model evaluation, and production readiness
  • Explore next-generation perception capabilities, including embedded and on-prem inference optimization for new deployment targets

What You’ll Need

  • 10+ years of experience in machine learning or computer vision
  • Deep expertise in CNNs, object detection, image segmentation, and OCR using PyTorch (preferred) or TensorFlow
  • Strong Python proficiency and software engineering fundamentals; hands-on experience with OpenCV and GPU computing
  • Track record of delivering production ML systems at scale, including model training, evaluation, and deployment
  • MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related field

Nice to Have

  • Experience with drone, robotics, or autonomous systems perception
  • Publications in top vision or robotics conferences (CVPR, ICCV, ICRA, NeurIPS, CoRL)
  • Experience designing and deploying models for real-time inference on constrained compute platforms
  • Warehouse, logistics, or supply chain domain experience

jobs.excerpt: About VitallyVitally is a Customer Success Platform built for modern teams.
jobs.description:
About Vitally

Vitally is a Customer Success Platform built for modern teams. We help CS organizations run smarter: better visibility into customer health, more efficient workflows, and stronger collaboration across the post-sale team. We're a small, high-trust organization that moves fast and cares a lot about doing this work well.

We are looking for a Director of Editorial & Content Marketing to help shape what the market believes about the future of Customer Success. We’re entering an important new chapter. AI is changing how customer-facing teams work, what companies can learn from every customer relationship, and what the next generation of Customer Success technology needs to do.

This is an opportunity to lead a new conversation in the market and we need a senior editorial leader to help us do it. You’ll own the editorial strategy that turns Vitally’s company and product vision into ideas people want to read, share, debate, and remember. You’ll build our thought leadership and research programs, develop distinctive executive voices, and create the sustained content engine that builds awareness, demand, and authority around Vitally.

This is not a content-production role or an editorial-calendar manager. We’re looking for someone who can identify the ideas worth owning and turn them into a market movement.

What you’ll do:

Build Vitally's editorial strategy

  • Define the ideas, topics, and conversations Vitally should own.
  • Create a cohesive editorial strategy across long-form, social, research, video, events, and other channels.
  • Build recurring editorial franchises that give our audience a reason to come back.
  • Develop the narrative arc that connects our company strategy, product vision, and point of view on the market.

Help shape a market movement

  • Turn Vitally’s perspective on AI, Customer Success, and customer intelligence into compelling market narratives.
  • Build sustained market education before, during, and after major launches.
  • Identify opportunities for Vitally to lead industry conversations rather than simply participate in them.
  • Create ideas and content that help buyers understand why the market needs to change before we ask them to buy the solution.

Build our thought leadership platform

  • Partner closely with Vitally executives to develop differentiated points of view and recognizable voices.
  • Turn executive expertise into strong social content, articles, talks, media opportunities, and industry commentary.
  • Build a consistent thought-leadership cadence without making it feel formulaic or manufactured.

Create original research

  • Develop proprietary research that gives Vitally something genuinely new to contribute to the market.
  • Build flagship research properties that can generate attention, earned media, backlinks, conversation, and demand.
  • Find interesting stories in customer, market, survey, and product data.

Create content that drives demand

  • Lead editorial strategy and quality across articles, reports, guides, newsletters, campaigns, video, and other formats.
  • Partner with Growth to turn editorial authority into organic traffic, audience growth, pipeline, and revenue.
  • Partner with Product Marketing to extend launches beyond product messaging into larger market stories.
  • Develop content that supports buyers across the journey—from discovering a problem to building urgency to evaluating Vitally.

What we’re looking for:

  • 10+ years of experience in editorial, content marketing, thought leadership, brand publishing, or a related discipline, ideally in B2B technology.
  • Experience owning editorial or content strategy at a senior level.
  • An exceptional writer and editor with strong instincts for what is interesting, distinctive, and worth saying.
  • A track record of creating content programs that build audiences and influence markets—not simply increase publishing volume.
  • Experience developing executive thought leadership.
  • Experience creating original research, reports, editorial franchises, or other high-authority content.
  • Strong understanding of how content creates demand across organic search, social, email, events, earned media, and other channels.
  • Ability to understand complex technology and turn it into simple, provocative, compelling stories.
  • Strong strategic judgment paired with a willingness to be hands-on when necessary.
  • The ability to operate in ambiguity and help shape the story while the company and product strategy are still evolving.

What success looks like within year one:

  • Vitally has a clear and differentiated editorial point of view.
  • The market increasingly associates Vitally with the future of Customer Success and customer intelligence.
  • Our executives have strong, recognizable thought-leadership platforms.
  • Vitally has launched compelling original research and recurring editorial franchises.
  • Major product launches are supported by months of market education—not just launch-day promotion.
  • Our owned audience and organic demand are growing.
  • Editorial programs are contributing meaningfully to pipeline and revenue.
  • Sales has stronger ideas, narratives, and content to create buyer urgency.
  • Vitally is increasingly recognized not just for the software we sell, but for the ideas we bring to the market.

Why Vitally:

Customer Success is changing quickly. AI can increasingly summarize information, automate administrative work, and execute tasks that once consumed much of a CSM’s day. The bigger opportunity is what happens next: what customer-facing people can accomplish with that capacity, what companies can learn from every customer, and how those insights can make an entire organization smarter.

Vitally is building toward that future. You’ll help make the market believe in it.

Benefits & Culture:

Compensation:We offer a competitive salary based on competitive market data, your experience, and geographic location. The US-based compensation range for this role is approximately $200,000 - $240,000.

Equity: We want every team member invested in the company's success and are happy to be generous with equity.

Benefits:

  • 401k through Empower
  • Commuter benefits

Our culture: We are committed to a productive and respectful work environment. Culturally, the team is extremely friendly, fun, hard-working, intelligent, and mature. That said, we don't believe in building a startup cult. We like each other, we support each other, we're a focused team, and we enjoy hanging out from time to time, but we enjoy and appreciate having our own lives outside of Vitally. If this resonates, Vitally could be a great place for you!

The Microsoft Certified Senior SharePoint Developer is the technical lead for everything users see and touch in the Enterprise SharePoint environment. The role designs and builds SharePoint Framework components, applications, templates and prototype pages; decides when a low-code Power Platform solution is the better answer than custom code; sets and enforces the coding, accessibility and documentation standards the team works to; and reviews the work of other developers before it reaches the Government. Section 508 conformance and change-package discipline are part of the definition of done, not a downstream review.

Key responsibilities:-

Solution design and development
  • Design, develop, and update web components and applications that support the agency, using the SharePoint Framework (SPFx) with TypeScript and React, PnPjs and the Microsoft Graph API (SOW Section 5).

Accessibility
  • Write all new code to Web Content Accessibility Guidelines 2.0 Levels A and AA and to the Revised Section 508 Standards, and ensure any change to existing code conforms in accordance with the required testing methods (SOW Section 5).
Change control and release
  • Package solutions with source control, versioning and repeatable deployment across Development, Test and Production; support deployment inside the approved maintenance window and back-out when invoked.

  • Responsive and mobile-first design for SharePoint Online.
  • Section 508 and WCAG 2.0 Level A and AA implementation, including remediation of existing components.
  • Migration and modernization of classic SharePoint pages, workflows and legacy customizations to supported modern patterns.
Required Certifications
  • Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert (MS-102) or equivalent.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Prior experience in a Microsoft 365 Government Community Cloud (GCC or GCC High) tenant.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer - 3D Web Service (copy)
jobs.excerpt: Satellite and drone imagery access is on the rise, and traditional image processing methods are struggling to keep up.
jobs.description:
Satellite and drone imagery access is on the rise, and traditional image processing methods are struggling to keep up. We've never had more data, turning those pixels into trusted, measurable understanding still takes months of AI work. HUNTR™ reduces this to hours.
We do not sell models. We provide the infrastructure that lets governments and enterprises build, validate, deploy and operate visual models they own. From pixel inputs to operational 2D and 3D outputs, under full sovereign control. Once deployed, every new sensor observation improves the customer's understanding of reality. Wherever the mission takes place, HUNTR™ runs there - from SaaS and private cloud to on-premise, classified networks and edge hardware in the field
We kicked off in 2020 and have secured $35 million in Series A funding from a lineup of top US and European investors, among which Microsoft M12, Point72 Ventures, Maxar, In-Q-Tel, SAFRAN, and ISAI/Capgemini.
The HUNTR™ workflow produces 3D outputs alongside 2D detections. Customers who need full simulation fidelity consume those through game engines. Others need to open the result in a browser, navigate it and make decision. We are looking for a Frontend Engineer to build a 3D viewer inside the HUNTR™ application.

Your Mission

  • Build the 3D viewer inside the HUNTR application that renders pipeline outputs as 3D Tiles in the browser, on the hardware analysts actually have.
  • Integrate the viewer into the end-to-end workflow. When a job finishes, the 3D result appears next to the imagery and detections that produced it, in the same interface, without a download step.
  • Design the interaction model for operational use: navigation, inspection, orientation between the 3D view and the underlying 2D data.
  • Work with the teams producing the tilesets on what the pipeline emits, so the browser consumes it directly and rendering constraints are fixed upstream rather than patched in the client.
  • Keep it performant on ordinary laptops. Tile size, texture compression, request patterns and load time are measured, not guessed.
  • Ship one viewer across SaaS, single-tenant cloud, on-premise and edge deployments.

Your Profile

  • You have strong practical experience with Vue.js and building complex, stateful single-page applications.
  • You have rendered 3D geospatial content in the browser with Cesium or an equivalent library, and you have worked with 3D Tiles or a comparable tiled 3D format
  • You have solid software engineering fundamentals: HTML, CSS, TypeScript, component and integration testing, CI/CD, performance profiling.
  • You are familiar with geospatial concepts: coordinate reference systems, raster vs. vector data, tiled data structures, GeoJSON.
  • You consume REST APIs and manage asynchronous state against long-running backend jobs
  • You have a strong sense for UX in technical products. You translate a complex workflow into a clear interface without stripping out its power.
  • You are outcome-oriented and take pride in shipping interfaces that users want to work in.

Tech Stack

  • Node.js, Vue.js, TypeScript
  • Cesium, 3D Tiles
  • OpenLayers
  • Cypress
  • REST APIs
  • Docker, Kubernetes

Why join us

  • Own the surface where 3D reaches the customer: every 3D result the pipeline produces ends in your viewer.
  • Real constraints: analysts on ordinary hardware, on-premise and edge deployments, and a result that has to be usable the moment the job finishes.
  • Diverse deployment challenges: ship a single application that runs in the cloud, on classified networks, or on a laptop in the field.
  • Strong technical culture: work alongside 3D graphics engineers, ML engineers and GIS specialists solving novel problems.
  • Competitive compensation with flexible working arrangements and personalized benefits including learning opportunities, mental wellbeing programs, and healthcare.
The minimum salary is 56.000,--€ gross per year. The effective salary depends on qualification and experience and may be significantly higher!

Estruturar e operar a frente de conteúdo e documentação do Partner Integration Ops, transformando documentação de subproduto em diferencial mensurável do serviço. A missão vai além de escrever: envolve desenhar e manter os fluxos de documentação e integração dos parceiros, apoiar a jornada do desenvolvedor no dev portal e sustentar o "Content Ops" como alavanca de valor — reduzindo tickets por deflection, acelerando o Time-to-First-Integration (TtFI) e aumentando a ativação de devs. É a peça que conecta documentação técnica, experiência do parceiro e a evolução do modelo Partner Hub Operations.

Award Management

Research Reporting

  • Provides analysis of online database of grants submitted, awarded, rejected, etc. metrics and funding trends.

Grant Closeout

  • Serves as responsible for closure of complex sponsored projects accounts.
  • Submits final progress report and invention statement (if applicable) to the appropriate agency.

Post Award

  • Serves as internal liaison and grant content representative with SPA to ensure that all funds are set up in a timely manner; prepares any necessary project advances, no-cost extensions, and ensures that funds are carried forward as appropriate.
  • Ensures that human and animal study protocols are associated with the applicable proposal or award.
  • Obtains documentation on participation of foreign nationals on research projects.
  • Coordinates the necessary support with internal and external requests for grant-related information (i.e. audit inquiries, effort distribution, trainee information, and human/animal protocol approvals,).
  • Stays in communication with the leadership on pre- and post-award activities to ensure the highest level of customer service to faculty.
  • Tracks and maintains online database of grants submitted, awarded, rejected, etc.
  • Prepares monthly financial reports on complex research accounts and distribute/discuss with PIs and senior leadership.
  • Assists DA in reconciling funds and monitoring spending levels, overdrafts, and cost sharing commitments. Processes budget adjustments on expense categories as needed.
  • Obtains signatures and forwards grant/contract financial status reports to PI and senior leadership.
  • Works with PIs to provide fund management and make any necessary budgetary changes.

  • May prepare and submit invoices according to final executed contract, track receipt of checks from sponsor and ensure they are deposited in correct fund.

  • Serves as responsible for coordinating all Center lectures, scientific forums, workshops, as well as advertising via e-mails/flyers/posters, etc.

MISSION

Mirum Pharmaceuticals is a biopharmaceutical company dedicated to transforming the treatment of rare diseases. We are passionate about advancing scientific discoveries to become important medicines for rare disease patients. We are collaborative, creative, and experienced professionals and we’re looking to augment our team with other individuals who embody our values: care, be real, get it done, and have fun, seriously.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Therapeutic Account Manager (TAM) is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable business performance and meaningful patient impact across an assigned territory. The TAM develops deep clinical and account expertise in rare cholestatic liver diseases and Mirum's Liver portfolio; identifies and prioritizes high-opportunity customers, accounts, and referral networks; and executes customized account plans that advance disease awareness, appropriate patient identification, treatment consideration, initiation, and persistence in accordance with approved indications and promotional practices.

The ideal TAM is not a transactional seller. This individual is a clinically credible, insight-led partner who engages healthcare professionals as a peer, asks thoughtful questions, constructively challenges clinical inertia, and influences change across complex accounts. The TAM works closely with the Regional Business Director and cross-functional partners to connect customer needs, patient journeys, referral pathways, access dynamics, and business opportunities while demonstrating curiosity, high emotional intelligence, resilience, ownership, and consistent follow-through.

JOB FUNCTIONS/RESPONSIBILITIES

Territory Strategy & Business Performance

  • Develop and execute a focused territory business plan aligned with national, zone, and regional priorities, with clear objectives, customer priorities, resource allocation, and measures of success.
  • Use performance data, customer insights, market intelligence, access dynamics, and competitive trends to identify opportunities, anticipate barriers, and make timely adjustments to territory strategy and execution.
  • Delivers territory business objectives through disciplined prioritization, high-quality customer engagement, effective resource stewardship, and accountability for both behaviors and results.
  • Maintain accurate and timely customer records, forecasts, expense reporting, required administrative documentation, and business updates in accordance with company expectations.

Strategic Account Management & Network Development

  • Identify, prioritize, and develop high-opportunity accounts, health systems, centers of excellence, and referral networks across pediatric and adult hepatology and gastroenterology.
  • Create and execute customized account plans that reflect the local patient journey, key stakeholders, clinical decision-making, referral patterns, access considerations, customer needs, and competitive realities.
  • Build trusted relationships with physicians, advanced practice providers, nurses, pharmacists, office staff, and other members of the care team by delivering relevant value and consistent follow-through.
  • Map influence and decision-making within complex accounts, establish clear objectives for each engagement, and secure appropriate next steps that advance the account strategy.
  • Coordinate compliant account actions across Mirum field partners, clarify ownership, and maintain momentum against agreed priorities and customer needs.

Clinical Aptitude & Customer Engagement

  • Develop and maintain deep knowledge of rare cholestatic liver disease, diagnostic pathways, mechanisms of action, clinical data, product profiles, approved uses, safety information, patient support pathways, access and reimbursement, and the evolving competitive landscape.
  • Communicate complex scientific and clinical information clearly, accurately, and credibly, tailoring the discussion to the knowledge, needs, and priorities of each healthcare professional and account.
  • Engage healthcare professionals as a clinically credible peer by asking insightful questions, listening actively, uncovering unmet needs, and connecting relevant evidence and resources to the customer's practice.
  • Execute approved promotional programs, resources, and customer engagements with consistency, clinical relevance, sound judgment, and full adherence to company policies and regulatory requirements.

Influence & Impact

  • Help customers recognize gaps in disease awareness, patient identification, referral, treatment consideration, and ongoing support by reframing issues and connecting insights across the patient journey.
  • Use high emotional intelligence, curiosity, credibility, and thoughtful questioning to build trust with skeptical, change-resistant, or highly experienced healthcare professionals.
  • Influence multiple stakeholders without authority, navigate resistance constructively, and balance persistence with judgment, empathy, and respect for customer boundaries

Customer, Patient & Caregiver Impact

  • Keep patients and caregivers at the center of territory and account decisions, with a clear understanding of the journey from disease recognition and diagnosis through treatment initiation and persistence.
  • Support a customer experience grounded in trust, empathy, responsiveness, urgency, and reliable follow-through with healthcare professionals and care teams.
  • Collaborate compliantly with Market Access and Patient Services partners to help care teams understand available resources and navigate appropriate barriers in the patient journey.
  • Identify recurring customer, access, and patient-support barriers; elevate them objectively and promptly; and partner with the appropriate internal teams to improve execution and support.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Field Insights

  • Build productive partnerships with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, Analytics, and Advocacy.
  • Work seamlessly across field roles to coordinate account strategy, align priorities, clarify responsibilities, and ensure consistent follow-through while respecting functional boundaries.
  • Capture and communicate timely, objective, and actionable field insights that can inform strategy, messaging, training, resource development, customer experience, and execution priorities.
  • Contribute actively to business reviews, training programs, team meetings, launch readiness, and cross-functional initiatives; share best practices and support the success of the broader organization.

Entrepreneurial Drive, Resilience & Culture

  • Operate with a high degree of ownership, self-motivation, resourcefulness, and initiative in an unstructured, rapidly evolving rare disease environment.
  • Create appropriate engagement opportunities in underdeveloped accounts and markets, test new approaches, learn quickly, and translate insights into action.
  • Maintain sustained drive, discipline, and performance through pressure, uncertainty, obstacles, delays, and discouragement; recover quickly and remain focused on long-term goals.
  • Demonstrate curiosity, coachability, and a commitment to continuous learning; actively seek feedback and apply coaching to strengthen clinical, strategic, and selling capabilities.
  • Model Mirum's values and the highest standards of ethical conduct, compliance, transparency, inclusion, and respect in every internal and external interaction.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of progressive sales experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Demonstrated track record of consistently delivering business results in a complex specialty, rare disease, orphan drug, or high-science market.
  • Rare disease experience is highly preferred; experience in hepatology, gastroenterology, pediatric specialty care, or another complex specialty market is highly desirable.
  • Strong clinical aptitude and demonstrated ability to learn, retain, and communicate complex disease-state, diagnostic, mechanism-of-action, clinical-data, and product information.
  • Experience with account-based selling across health systems, centers of excellence, multidisciplinary care teams, referral networks, and influential healthcare professionals.
  • Demonstrated ability to use insight-led or challenger-style selling to constructively challenge the status quo, influence behavior, and advance customer decision-making.
  • Working knowledge of access and reimbursement dynamics, patient support pathways, and the role of patient services in rare disease markets.
  • Strong business acumen and ability to interpret performance data, identify insights, develop territory and account strategies, and translate plans into consistent field execution.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence, communication, presentation, judgment, and ability to build trust with diverse and highly sophisticated customers.
  • Proven self-motivation, resourcefulness, resilience, organization, and ability to prioritize and perform independently in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.
  • Demonstrated success partnering cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Market Access, Patient Services, Marketing, Commercial Training and Effectiveness, Operations, and Analytics.
  • Commitment to ethical conduct, compliance, and approved promotional practices, with sound judgment in complex customer and patient-related situations.
  • Valid driver's license and ability to travel up to 70%, including frequent overnight travel and occasional weekend commitments.

The Center for Biological Diversity is currently looking for ten full-time Law Clerks for Summer 2027 who share an interest in and passion for justice and environmental protection. Clerks will be hired and then assigned to a program—either Oceans, Carnivore Conservation, the Climate Law Institute, Endangered Species, Public Lands, Urban Wildlands, or Environmental Health. (Other programs and other locations may be hiring separately. Interested applicants are welcome to apply for those positions as well). The expectation is that clerks will work full-time hours (40 hours per week). The typical clerkship lasts ten weeks.

All clerkship positions may be completed remotely. Applicants also have the option to work in person at the following office locations:

  • Climate Law Institute: Oakland, California or Washington, D.C.
  • Urban Wildlands Program: Oakland, California
  • Oceans Program: Oakland, California
  • Endangered Species Program: Portland, Oregon

The following programs are remote-only:

  • Carnivore Conservation Program
  • Public Lands Program
  • Environmental Health Program

Depending on office capacity limitations, remote-only clerks may have the option to work from a Center office. If you would like to work remotely from a Center office, please indicate your office preference(s) in your cover letter.

To apply, please upload a:

1. cover letter explaining your interest in working at the Center, your program placement preference (if any), and your office location or remote preference (see explanation above for location options);

2. resume;

3. writing sample, preferably of no more than 10 pages that reflects your own legal analysis;

4. transcript (unofficial is fine); and

5. list of three references.

Please submit all application materials via our website at .

Incomplete applications will not be considered. Application review will begin September 15, 2026, but applications will continue to be accepted until the positions are filled. The desired start date is May 17, 2027. You will be notified if you are selected for an interview. No telephone calls, please.

ABOUT THE CENTER
The Center for Biological Diversity, a national 501(c)(3) non-profit organization, believes the welfare of human beings is deeply linked to nature — to the existence of a vast diversity of wild animals, plants, and people. Because diversity has intrinsic value, and because its loss impoverishes society, we work to secure a future for all species, great and small, hovering on the brink of extinction. We do so through science, law, activism, and creative media, with a focus on protecting the lands, waters, and climate that humans, other species, and all communities need to survive and thrive.

We want those who come after us to inherit a world where the wild is still alive.

POSITION SUMMARY
Attorneys at the Center for Biological Diversity work on issues as varied as endangered species, ocean protection, climate change, environmental health, water resources, biomass energy, the protection of public lands, and land use in the urban-wildland interface. Law clerks work on environmental law and litigation projects designed to have a conservation impact. They will work with experienced attorneys who provide supervision, training, and mentorship. Clerks will usually be assigned to a program area that aligns with their interests in endangered species, ocean protection, climate change, public lands, environmental health, or carnivore conservation. Law clerks assist with legal research and writing, litigation, and administrative advocacy.

POSITIONS BEING HIRED

The Center is hiring a total of ten clerks. One clerk position is available at each of the following programs: Oceans, Environmental Health, Urban Wildlands, and Carnivore Conservation. Two clerk positions are available at each of the following programs: Public Lands, Endangered Species, and Climate Law Institute.

  • Conduct legal research and writing, including preparing legal memoranda, assisting with brief writing, preparing filings, investigating new projects, and drafting public comments;
  • Conduct research and review administrative regulations and other policy proposals;
  • May have opportunities to present at administrative hearings and observe court arguments or agency proceedings;
  • Assist with interviewing experts;
  • Collaborate with coalitions and partners;
  • Analyze federal and state legislation relating to endangered species, public lands, oceans, energy, and pollution;
  • Track current legislation in Congress relating to the Endangered Species Act, public-land laws, climate and energy laws, marine mammal protection, National Environmental Policy Act, and Clean Air Act;
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

AREAS IN WHICH SKILLS WILL BE GAINED

Clerks will gain experience in legal research and writing, and environmental advocacy, particularly in the natural resources area, drawing on litigation, science, media, and grassroots organizing strategies to fight for wildlife and their habitats.

ESSENTIAL QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS

  • Completed at least one year of law school at time of application;
  • Strong legal research and writing skills;
  • Passionate about protecting wildlife and their habitats;
  • Commitment to equity and justice;
  • Background or experience in natural resources, environmental, and/or administrative law preferred and scientific literacy preferred;
  • Creativity and motivation.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Unilever Food Solutions (UFS) ist die zweitgrößte Geschäftseinheit von Unilever, eine der drei Power-Marken der Foods Business Group und ein globaler Marktführer im Bereich Food Service. Wir sind eine unabhängige globale Geschäftseinheit, die in über 76 Ländern tätig ist, einen Umsatz von rund 3 Milliarden Euro erwirtschaftet und rund 4000 Mitarbeitenden beschäftigt. Wir haben ein einzigartiges B2B-Geschäftsmodell, das sich auf die Dienen von Köch*innen konzentriert. Unser Ziel ist es, sie so zu entlasten, damit lieben was sie tun.

Wir bei UFS haben eine mutige und klare Ambition und Strategie, um bis 2030 einen Umsatz von 5 Milliarden Euro mit wachsender Rentabilität zu erreichen, indem wir der beste Lösungsanbieter für unsere 5 Millionen Betreibenden sind. Wir planen dies durch einen produktorientierten Fokus auf Überlegenheit, indem wir zum führenden Anbieter von KI-gestützter Kundenerfahrung werden und eine Gewinnerkultur pflegen. In den letzten Jahren haben wir eine Geschichte der Exzellenz und widerstandsfähigen Leistung geliefert. Wir streben auch danach, der Branche immer drei Schritte voraus zu sein. Zum Beispiel identifiziert unser Future Menus Report aufkommende kulinarische Trends und macht uns zu einem Trendsetter für inspirierende innovative Lösungen für Köch*innen weltweit.

Diese Rolle hat den Zweck, nachhaltiges Wachstum in unserem Foodservice-Geschäft voranzutreiben und starke, langfristige Partnerschaften mit unserer Kundschaft aufzubauen. Durch die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Geschäftsbeziehungen, die Gewinnung neuer Kundenunternehmen und die erfolgreiche Verankerung unserer Lösungen im Markt leistest du einen entscheidenden Beitrag zum Erfolg von Unilever Food Solutions.

Du wirst Teil eines Teams, das daran glaubt, Arbeit mit Sinn zu leisten – für Menschen und den Planeten. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir unsere Kundschaft dabei, ihre Betriebe erfolgreich weiterzuentwickeln und innovative Lösungen für die professionelle Küche einzusetzen.

Description
Dit is voornamelijk een backoffice functie, met af en toe ondersteuning voor frontoffice-activiteiten wanneer dat nodig is. De rol biedt een gestructureerde werkomgeving waarin je uitdagingen aangaat zonder de typische druk van een callcenter. In plaats daarvan krijg je de kans je te richten op belangrijke dossiers die direct invloed hebben op klanttevredenheid, terwijl je deel uitmaakt van een ondersteunend team. Je gebruikt dagelijks je Nederlandse taalvaardigheden en met een volledige training biedt deze rol een rustige, samenwerkende werksfeer en echte doorgroeimogelijkheden.

Wat kun je verwachten:
- Mogelijkheid om fulltime of parttime te werken.
- Inwerkperiode (ongeveer 1 maand) en daarna blijvende ondersteuning bij dagelijkse taken.
- Duidelijk ontwikkelpad en reële doorgroeimogelijkheden – meer dan 90% van de promoties naar hogere functies worden ingevuld door interne medewerkers.
- Flexibele werktijden die passen bij jouw behoeften (maandag t/m vrijdag tussen 08:00 en 18:00 uur).
- Werving beloningssysteem – verdien tot 500.000 HUF bruto bij het aandragen van een nieuwe collega.
- Relocatie Pakket – wij ondersteunen je reis tot 100 EUR en je accommodatie voor 30 dagen.
- In de eerste 3 maanden ontwikkel je communicatieve vaardigheden en leer je gesprekken voeren binnen vastgestelde kaders.
- Diverse extra voordelen: regelmatige kantoor-massages, fruitdagen, cafetariasysteem, vergoeding voor thuiswerken, particuliere ziektekostenverzekering, levens- en ongevallenverzekering, prestatiebonus en vele evenementen.

Hoe ziet een typische werkdag eruit?
Je dag is gericht op het afhandelen van claims, schades en leveringsproblemen voor zakelijke klanten, particuliere klanten en preferred klanten. Je beheert dossiers met oog voor detail en een klantgerichte instelling, om zo naadloze ondersteuning en tevredenheid te waarborgen.
Belangrijkste taken zijn:
- Claims en schademeldingen snel en nauwkeurig verwerken.
- Professioneel communiceren in geschreven Nederlands met klanten en partners.
- Onderzoeken van problemen met leveringen en samenwerken met interne teams om deze op te lossen.
- Meerdere dossiers tegelijk beheren in een dynamische omgeving.

Jij staat bekend om:
- Vloeiend Nederlands, met uitstekende schriftelijke communicatievaardigheden voor duidelijke en professionele klantinteracties.
- Goede beheersing van het Engels voor effectieve interne communicatie en training.
- Een sterk begrip van service-excellence en het vermogen om zakelijke klanten, particuliere klanten en preferred klanten met zorg te ondersteunen.
- Zelfvertrouwen bij het voeren van incidentele uitgaande gesprekken, met name voor follow-up of in een professionele context.

Zo ziet het Transcom leven er uit!
Bij Transcom zijn we onvermoeibaar toegewijd. Aan onze klanten en aan elkaar. Elke dag begint iemand aan zijn of haar reis bij Transcom. Ze nemen het potentieel dat ze vandaag hebben en zetten dat om in vaardigheden voor de toekomst. Ze worden gewaardeerd om hun harde werk, hun teamgeest en hun steun aan anderen. Ze zetten zich in voor positieve, blijvende veranderingen in hun teams en gemeenschappen. Zo zijn we bij Transcom. Hier geven we om elkaar en moedigen we elkaar aan. Je wordt vanaf dag één geaccepteerd zoals je bent. En met de juiste mentaliteit zijn er geen grenzen aan wat we samen kunnen bereiken.

We are seeking a Memory & System Architecture Research Intern with a strong computer-architecture and systems-modeling background to characterize AI workloads and help build and validate performance models for advanced memory systems. You will translate AI workload trends into memory capacity, bandwidth, and latency requirements, and quantify architectural tradeoffs to inform long-term technology and product direction. This role suits a graduate or Ph.D. student who is comfortable in ambiguous problem spaces and enjoys turning hypotheses into quantified, published evidence. Applying Artificial Intelligence is expected as part of this position.


Key Responsibilities

  • Workload characterization: Analyze AI training and inference workloads to derive memory bandwidth, capacity, and latency requirements.
  • System modeling: Contribute to analytical and simulation models that evaluate memory-centric system architectures at scale.
  • Architecture studies: Assess system-level tradeoffs across emerging memory and integration technologies.
  • Validation & accuracy: Benchmark models against reference data to improve accuracy and ensure reproducible results.
  • Quantified analysis: Produce system-level performance, efficiency, and cost analyses that inform architectural decisions.
  • Documentation & publishing: Capture findings in internal technical reports and contribute to invention disclosures where applicable.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Currently pursuing an M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Architecture, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
  • Strong background in computer architecture and system-level performance analysis (memory hierarchy, bandwidth, latency, scaling).
  • Ability to analyze complex memory and AI performance challenges and reason about tradeoffs quantitatively.
  • Proficiency in Python for building analytical models and performance analysis.
  • Good verbal and written communication and problem-solving abilities.


Preferred Qualifications

  • Understanding of memory architectures (HBM, DDR, LPDDR, CXL, emerging memories) and their impact on AI/ML workloads.
  • Understanding of near-memory and advanced integration technologies — 3D stacking, chiplets, interposers, heterogeneous packaging — and their system-level tradeoffs.
  • Experience with AI systems and accelerators (GPU/ASIC), performance benchmarking, or design-space exploration.
  • Familiarity with simulation frameworks and reproducible experimentation.


What You'll Gain

Turn architecture hypotheses into quantified, published evidence that shapes next-generation memory technology and product direction, while working alongside senior memory and systems architects on some of the most challenging problems in AI infrastructure.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant (Remote, UK/EU, £38k-£43k/year)
jobs.excerpt: Ellipsis is emerging as a market leader in “GEO” for B2B technology companies.
jobs.description:
Ellipsis is emerging as a market leader in “GEO” for B2B technology companies. This is a high-impact, hands-on role in a fast-moving and ambitious agency.

The transition to AI search has put a lot of the SEO industry on the back foot. Ellipsis has always been consultative/strategic in our approach, we started building AI search products in 2021 on GPT-2, and thus this has been a time for us to thrive.

Today, we think we have a better understanding of AI search than almost anyone else. We have both the tracking product (built in-house), the data (~25 million AI answers for analysis, with more tracked weekly), and the execution end-to-end from strategy, to writing, to in-house design, to optimisation, and performance reporting.

We're looking for an Executive Assistant to help our Founder and Managing Director, Alex, and our Chief of Staff, Anna, make the best possible use of their time, while ensuring important work across the business is prepared, coordinated and followed through. You'll provide day-to-day EA support to Alex and work closely with Anna on wider business matters.

You will be the metronome that helps the business keep moving. Your work will be extremely high-impact, and you’ll be involved at a high level across the business. This is not a general operations role: your focus is excellent executive support, careful coordination and practical follow-through.

This position can be broken down as follows:

60% support to Alex.

40% support to Anna on wider business priorities, including finance and people administration.

Remote work requires trust, and in this role this will be absolutely critical. Trust is built over time, and accordingly your responsibilities will grow over time. Our hope is that you will prove indispensable to the business, but we understand it will take months to get to this place. Thus, below is a list of some of the responsibilities you’ll be able to grow into over time.

Support to Alex

Your most important responsibility is helping Alex maximise his time, protect his attention, reduce unnecessary context-switching, and stay focused on the work where he adds the most value.

  • Calendar management: Own and manage Alex’s diary and calendar. Protect focused work and create space for strategic priorities. Make sensible scheduling decisions using your knowledge of Alex’s priorities, resolve clashes proactively, and account for preparation, travel time, location, time zones and the purpose of each meeting. Challenge or reorganise meetings where there is a better use of Alex’s time, and make sure Alex has the right preparation and information before important meetings.
  • Inbox and communication: Assist the Managing Director with maintaining an organised and efficient inbox, including drafting replies or responding directly on his behalf at times. Effectively triage emails, understand possible courses of action, and present information to Alex in a way that lets him quickly provide a batch of responses that unblock you. Chase outstanding replies, actions and commitments, and build templates and systems for recurring email patterns so that important messages and obligations do not disappear.
  • Briefings: Prepare a clear, concise morning briefing for Alex at the start of each day before he logs on (8.30am uk), giving him an overview of his schedule, priorities, deadlines, outstanding decisions and follow-up. Monitor his relevant communication channels, use judgement to identify what needs his attention, and make sure he is reminded of important to-dos, commitments and preparation ahead of time. These briefings are sometimes also required in the afternoon.
  • Day-to-day tasks: The remit of this role is not “follow this clearly defined process every time”, but “take this mostly finished project and figure out how to proactively take it to completion”. These tasks might touch project management, writing/editing, triaging information, posting on LinkedIn, research, drafting communications and ensuring action is taken. You’ll need to work out the information, stakeholders, decisions and follow-up required, rather than waiting for every task to arrive as a fully documented process.
  • Meetings: Prepare for meetings, including ensuring slides, agendas and internal notes are prepared. Your goal is to ensure we utilise meeting time most effectively and are able to put our best foot forward. Use approved AI tools to capture and summarise meetings where appropriate, then check the output for accuracy and missing nuance. Extract decisions, actions, owners and deadlines; create follow-up tasks and communications; and make sure agreed actions are completed. This is about excellent preparation and follow-through, rather than traditional minute-taking as an end in itself.
  • Travel: Coordinate complex travel for Alex. Prepare clear itineraries and manage flights, hotels, transport, meetings, dinners and contingencies.
  • Occasional personal administration: This is a business-focused role and the overwhelming responsibility is with the business. You may be occasionally asked to take care of personal admin for Alex where this meaningfully protects his time.

Support to Anna and the wider business

You will report directly to Anna. Outside of supporting Alex, your role is to help her deliver wider team and business priorities.

  • Finance administration: This is an important part of the role. Support Anna with Ellipsis's day-to-day finance administration. This includes filing expenses, collecting invoices and receipts, preparing client invoices for review, gathering freelancer and supplier invoices, preparing payment information for approval, and chasing late client payments. You'll keep records accurate and tidy, help manage the finance inbox, and flag discrepancies promptly. Anna and our accountants remain responsible for payroll, pensions, compliance and all accounting decisions - your role is to make sure the inputs are complete, accurate and on time.
  • People and team support: Support Anna with people administration. Keep HR records up to date, prepare routine paperwork, help coordinate onboarding and offboarding, track key dates such as probation reviews and contract renewals, and support recruitment logistics - scheduling interviews, managing candidate communications and keeping the pipeline tidy. You'll also help create a positive remote-team experience through thoughtful internal communications, recognition, celebrations and team rituals.
  • Company meet-ups: Organise Ellipsis’s company meet-ups, including researching and budgeting locations, booking travel and accommodation, and arranging restaurants, meeting rooms and activities. You’ll need to think carefully about cost, travel time, comfort, accessibility, dietary requirements and contingencies to create a productive and smooth trip for the whole team.
  • Wider business priorities: Take on well-scoped work that helps Anna and the Senior Leadership Team move wider company priorities forward. This might include preparing information and options, coordinating input from colleagues, drafting communications, updating trackers, following up actions and taking a partly formed request through to a reliable conclusion.
  • Travel and conference support: Support Anna, Alex and, occasionally, other Leadership Team members with conference travel. This includes booking flights and hotels, preparing clear itineraries, organising client dinners or agreed gifts, and looking for ways to make their time away from the business as effective as possible.
  • Confidentiality and judgement: You will handle confidential information relating to the business and team. You must use discretion, keep records accurate and know when a sensitive issue, decision or uncertainty needs to be escalated to Anna.

Requirements

Requirements: hard skills

  • 2-4 years experience in an Executive Assistant or similar role; similar roles might include Personal Assistant, Team Assistant, Business Support Coordinator, Office Manager, Project Manager
  • Impeccable English written and spoken communication and editorial skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail
  • Experience working remotely full time
  • Availability to work 8am - 5pm UK time (or earlier)
  • AI native: Confident using approved AI tools and automations to research, draft, summarise, organise and streamline administrative work. Able to write effective prompts, build repeatable workflows, review outputs critically for accuracy, tone and confidentiality, and recognise when human judgement or escalation is required.

Requirements: soft skills

  • Fantastic communication skills: Remote work relies on mutual trust, so frequent and clear written communication is essential
  • Receptive to feedback and solutions-oriented: We share and learn from each other honestly, openly, and easily
  • A people person with a high level of self-awareness: You'll work daily with Alex, Anna, the wider team, suppliers, our accountants and client finance teams, so warmth, tact and good judgement about people are integral to the role
  • Proven organisational skills: You must be obsessive with deadlines, managing and updating tasks, and totally reliable
  • Self-driven work ethic: You need to be self-motivated, comfortable taking the initiative, and see projects through to completion
  • Unwaveringly professional: You’ll be dealing with confidential information constantly and must be discreet and professional with this
  • Calm when priorities change: You should be comfortable handling a mixture of planned and reactive work without losing sight of what matters most.
  • Appetite for growth: As you build trust and company context, there will be scope for more sophisticated support to Alex, more complex Anna projects, deeper people and finance coordination, and practical AI and process improvements.

Your capability matters a lot more to us than your experience, and we would recommend you tailor your application with this in mind. We want to hear from you rather than ChatGPT. Please keep this in mind in particular with the screening questions.

Benefits

  • This is a full-time, 100% remote role (UK/EU based). Work from home, or the beach!
  • 28 days of paid holiday
    • An additional 1 paid holiday day a year with each year of tenure, up to a maximum of 5 additional days
  • 4-day work week, once a month (instead of local bank holidays seeing as we are based across the world)
  • Regular team retreats; last was Istanbul, previously in Edinburgh, Oxford, Madrid, and Budapest
  • Support for your growth, whether that’s upskilling, training, or exploring the direction you want to develop in
  • Enhanced maternity/paternity leave, and sick pay

The application process

It's important we find the best candidate for this position, and our selection process will reflect this.

Much of our company Wiki is externally accessible, and you're encouraged to read through this before applying. We have a very useful guide to our interview process available here. This tells you what we're looking for and reading this will significantly increase your chance of success!

We'll review applications on a rolling basis but interviews start after the closing date. There's thus no benefit to rushing to apply: we will bias heavily towards your application's answers rather than your CV, and we'd love for you to take your time.

We're fortunate to receive a large volume of applications. You can make your application stand out by paying special attention to the main responsibilities of this role, and "how to apply". If you think you're a fit, or could be a fit – go for it!

We use video calls for interviews. You'll have video interviews using Google Meet, including with members of the Leadership Team and the Founder.

We understand that this is as much you interviewing us, as the other way round. Throughout the interview process, we're extremely happy to answer your questions about the business, working here, and the future of the company.

The final stage of our hiring process is a paid test project, which will be similar to work you could expect to do if you were hired. We'll give you a week to complete the project, and expect it to be 4-6 hours of work.

Following the completion of trial projects, we'll ask for professional references from your previous 2 managers. We ask candidates to introduce us to their references, for a 10 minute call.

We do great work for clients and are building an ethical business that lets everyone do their best work. If you think you could be the next person to join our team, please apply :)

How to apply

Please apply through Workable: . We will decide who progresses to the next stage based on the form you submit, and your CV. Please give us a good reason to select you! Taking the time to research the role, what we're looking for, what we do, and what you can do for us will increase your chance of success. Your cover letter is where you have the space to do this. Please do not email either Anna or Alex, this will not help your application.

Ellipsis is an equal opportunity workplace and is committed to equal employment opportunity.

The deadline for submission is the end of the day, on 20 September 2026.

jobs.excerpt: Simplex Health is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) to provide telehealth outpatient nutrition counseling in an integrative/functional nutrition setting.
jobs.description:
Simplex Health is seeking a Registered Dietitian (RD/RDN) to provide telehealth outpatient nutrition counseling in an integrative/functional nutrition setting. This is a PRN (as-needed) role requiring a minimum of 15 hours of weekly availability, with the opportunity to offer additional hours if desired. The ideal candidate has experience in clinical or outpatient nutrition counseling, is licensed (or eligible for licensure) in Pennsylvania, and is passionate about delivering personalized, root-cause care to support long-term health outcomes.

Our Mission: Radically improve the health of Humankind-one person, one appointment, one connection at a time.

At Simplex Health, we do things differently. Our insurance-funded medical nutrition therapy goes beyond symptom management to improve — and in many cases reverse — chronic conditions. We partner with hospitals, healthcare practices, and individuals to provide personalized, root-cause nutrition care across a wide range of conditions, including metabolic health, digestive disorders, hormonal imbalances, and chronic disease.

Our approach is grounded in prevention, root-cause resolution, and sustainable lifestyle change, supporting patients throughout their health journey. Through a fully virtual, telehealth model, we meet patients where they are, delivering accessible, high-quality care.

Our evidence-based, progressive nutrition interventions are tailored to each patient’s unique biochemistry. Through nutrition counseling, education, and health coaching, we empower patients to improve their health, build lasting habits, and achieve meaningful, long-term outcomes.

Role details:

  • Location: Telehealth
  • Schedule: PRN / flexible with consistent weekly availability
  • Reports to: Senior Clinical Director
  • Compensation: $55 to $60 hourly

You love helping women feel confident and supported during pregnancy, especially when navigating challenges like gestational diabetes. You just don’t love doing it all alone.

If you’ve ever run or dreamed of running your own private practice, you know what it takes. The marketing, the scheduling, the billing, the insurance headaches, the empty calendar days, the tech issues, and the isolation.

At Simplex Health, you get the best parts of private practice, including autonomy, flexibility, and deep one-on-one relationships with patients, without the burnout or business stress.

Here, you get to focus on what you do best: helping women through pregnancy, gestational diabetes (GDM), and hormone-related conditions using an integrative and functional nutrition approach.

What we are looking for:
We are seeking mission-driven dietitians (RD/RDN) who:

  • Are passionate about women’s health, pregnancy, and gestational diabetes (GDM)
  • Take an integrative and functional nutrition approach to care
  • Thrive in a collaborative, growth-minded environment
  • Have at least 2 years of experience in outpatient or clinical care
  • Have experience or strong interest in prenatal nutrition, GDM, or hormone-related conditions
  • Hold current registration with CDR
  • Minimum of 15 hours of weekly availability required, with flexibility and opportunity to increase hours over time based on your preferences and schedule
  • Are credentialed or open to being credentialed with insurance companies
  • Want to spend more time with patients and less time running a business
  • To avoid conflicts of interest, candidates should not maintain an active private practice or independent nutrition counseling business

Preferred:

  • Availability for evening appointments strongly preferred to meet patient demand, with flexibility based on individual scheduling needs.
  • CDCES (Certified Diabetes Care and Education Specialist) strongly preferred
  • IFNA Certified (IFNCP credential a plus); candidates actively enrolled in IFNA training welcome
  • Prior experience supporting pregnant patients or managing gestational diabetes

PA license and completion of major insurance credentialing required before start; this process may take 3–6 months.

Role Responsibilities (including but not limited to):

  • Provide telehealth medical nutrition therapy using a functional and integrative approach, with a primary focus on pregnancy and gestational diabetes (GDM)
  • Assess nutritional health of patients/clients with attention to prenatal needs, blood sugar regulation, and hormone-related conditions
  • Monitor and review daily blood glucose logs for GDM patients, providing timely feedback, adjustments, and ongoing support
  • Educate and train patients on proper use of glucose meters and blood sugar monitoring techniques
  • Develop and modify individualized nutrition care plans, with a focus on glycemic control during pregnancy
  • Coordinate care and communicate effectively with referring physicians and healthcare providers to ensure continuity of care
  • Implement Simplex Health protocols and materials in patient care
  • Document all new and follow-up appointments in the Healthie platform with strong attention to detail
  • Respond to all patient communications in a timely and supportive manner
  • Communicate openly and effectively to resolve work-related issues or conflicts
  • Proactively contribute to team collaboration and support team decisions and outcomes
  • Adhere to all company policies and procedures
  • Stay current and forward-thinking with emerging research in women’s health, prenatal nutrition, and diabetes care
  • Manage a full and consistent patient caseload, ensuring timely follow-ups, continuity of care, and optimal patient outcomes
  • Maintain a minimum of 15 hours of weekly availability, with opportunity to grow into a higher-hour or full-time schedule

What to expect:

At Simplex Health, you’ll have access to:

  • Structured onboarding and training
  • Regular case reviews and clinical collaboration
  • Real-time support via team chat and peer connection
  • Team meetings and shared learning opportunities
  • Opportunities to contribute to committees, resources, and clinical initiatives
  • Credentialing: If you’re not yet in-network, our team fully manages the insurance credentialing process on your behalf, including covering all associated fees and handling the paperwork.
  • Ramp-Up To Full-Time: This role begins in a ramp-up phase with variable hours as your patient caseload grows, transitioning into a full-time, salaried schedule once full-time metrics are met. Our team provides consistent referrals and support to help you build a full and sustainable schedule as quickly as possible.

Benefits

  • Flexible Scheduling: Set your availability with the ability to build and adjust your schedule based on your preferences and patient demand
  • Supplement Commissions: Earn 12.5% of MSRP on supplements purchased through Fullscript, providing additional earning potential.
  • Performance-Based Bonus Opportunities: Earn additional income based on patient retention and face-to-face care time.
  • Paid Time Off (PTO): Accrue 1 hour of PTO for every 12 hours of patient care, supporting flexibility and time away as you work.
  • Discretionary Holiday Break: Office closed between Christmas and New Year’s
  • Fitness Allowance: Partial reimbursement for gym memberships, fitness classes, or wellness activities
  • Simplex Wellness on Demand: Free access to virtual fitness programs

Key Intangible Characteristics of the Ideal Candidate:

Called: A passion for our mission and a sense that this role and company are a strong fit for the blessings of your gifts, talents, passions, and experiences.. Must be mission-motivated with a resolve to overcome obstacles, anchored in a sense of purpose in this work.

Servant Leadership: Nobody is above any task, and we are all here to serve others. Every customer—internal or external—needs help, and the most powerful way to lead will be to serve.

Learning and Adaptive: As a startup with a big mission, new systems, technology, and situational adaptability are expected. This person must have an appetite for learning and skill improvement.

Grit, Resourcefulness & Entrepreneurial Spirit: Not everything will have a pre-planned solution. This person will have to be resourceful in figuring things out, resist feeling overwhelmed, and be willing to roll up their sleeves to make things happen. This person will have to have an open mind and good resolve, whether it’s looping in other people, finding answers online, or seeking best practices.

Organizational Skills: Being or becoming a constant organizational force. It will require a capacity for being open to change, discerning better processes, and prioritizing for improved outcomes.

Chemistry Fit: We have a unique and fun culture—we laugh, press in, work hard, and jump in to figure things out. Fitting into the team chemistry is essential.

High Character: We operate with a high trust culture. Personal values must fuel our work. Integrity, honesty, compassion, reconciliation, and diligence are all things this person must possess to flourish.

Energy & Enthusiasm: This person must bring joy and passion for work to the job. Encouraging and spurring on others on the mission while being self-motivated and positive is essential.

Multitasking: This is not a steady-state or static environment. Workflow will cycle, and interruptions are normal, so this person must be able to juggle and adjust on the fly.

Project Management: While multitasking, this person must be able to keep an eye on deadlines and critical dependencies, working to preserve them or source support proactively.

🌟 Why Dietitians Choose Simplex Health

Because great clinicians deserve great support.

🧾 We Handle Credentialing & Licensing
We cover insurance credentialing costs and reimburse for out-of-state license fees.

🎓 CEU Reimbursement
We invest in your professional growth and continued learning.

💻 Technology Reimbursement
Support for the tools you need to work efficiently and effectively.

💲 Recruitment Thank You Bonus
Bonus for any referrals hired by Simplex Health who stay at least 90 days

📋 Consistent Referrals & Quality Resources
A steady patient flow and high-quality patient-facing materials to support your care.

👥 Helpful Support Team & Quick Response Times
From scheduling to tech help, our support staff makes your day run smoother.

🌿 Approachable Leadership & Collaborative Culture
Leaders who listen, and a clinical community that truly supports one another.

🤝 Opportunities Beyond Patient Care
Get involved with social media, engagement projects, or hosting lunch & learns.

🌎 Broad Range of Clients, Deep Skill Development
Grow your counseling skills and confidence across a variety of cases.

💞 Strong Sense of Community
Even in a virtual environment, you’ll feel connected, encouraged, and supported.

If you’ve ever wished you could combine the freedom of private practice with the camaraderie and stability of a larger organization, this is where you belong.

Apply today and rediscover the joy of patient care without the grind of running a business.

Simplex Health Core Values:

Simplex Health strives to embody the following values and to apply them to every aspect of how we run our business, including how we interact with each other as teammates and leaders. These values also apply to how we interact with and continue to inspire our clients and strategic partners:

We Inspire Each Other
You are an important part of our team and together we make a collective intention to uplift and commit to one another. Through cultivating genuine, transparent, relationships, we create an environment that encourages individuals to dream big, take risks, and be bold. We aim to inspire and commit to everyone we touch. This sense of commitment and care sets the stage for a culture of accountability, where we hold ourselves and each other to the same high standards, taking the ownership necessary for achieving our goals.
Therefore encourage one another and build each other up, just as in fact you are doing.
1 Thessalonians 5:11

We Always Learn and Grow
We at Simplex Health strive to be continual learners and to expand our abilities as people and as an organization. We educate ourselves, remain curious, and use evidence-based research to challenge our current understanding. We see mistakes and failure as great teachers and learning opportunities. When we stay engaged in the world with a growth mindset, it creates the right environment for us to thrive and make a meaningful impact on each other and on the world.
Let the wise hear and increase in learning, and the one who understands obtain guidance.
Proverbs 1:5

We Think Big Picture What we do day in, day out, how we do it, and the decisions we make- shape who we are as a people and as a company. The details are super important, AND should always be guided by our wide perspective and an understanding of how we are impacting each other, our clients, and our business. Before making any major decision, ask yourself:

• Does it help us grow? How?

• Does it answer “how are we different and why should you care?”
• Is what I’m working on duplicatable and transferable (ie can I duplicate it and apply to other situations)? How?
• Does it challenge the status quo?
• Does it inspire?
• Does it tightly align with and advance our mission? How?
• Can it be more humanized and relatable?
• Does it unite us? How?
• Does it solve a problem? How?
Now we see things imperfectly, like puzzling reflections in a mirror, but then we will see everything with perfect clarity. All that I know now is partial and incomplete, but then I will know everything completely, just as God now knows me completely.
I Corinthians 13:12

We Challenge the Status Quo:
We are inquisitive by nature. We are courageous! We are not afraid to go against the grain in our search for truth. We always question conventional wisdom- it’s how Simplex Health started- it’s what we do.
Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God’s will is—his good, pleasing and perfect will. Romans 12:2

We Cultivate Health and Vitality:
Being alive in a body is an incredible, temporary experience. Even though at times we feel pain and face challenges, our next breath is not guaranteed and is a HUGE gift. We experience EVERYTHING through our bodies, including thoughts, emotions, spirit, and our inspiration. We see health and vitality as the foundation for living a life that is happy, fulfilled, present, and productive.
Dear friend, I pray that you may enjoy good health and that all may go well with you, even as your soul is getting along well.
3 John 1:2

We Embody Integrity:
We communicate with transparency and face conflict head-on. We do this with the understanding that we respect each other and recognize that we are on the same team working toward a unified noble mission with shared goals. We don’t compromise our morals or integrity no matter the context. When challenging scenarios arise, we approach them with honesty and trust that we are all holding the highest intentions, are committed to our values, and are making best efforts.
Do to others as you would have them do to you.
Luke 6:31

We Simplify the Complicated:
We believe that complex problems don’t always require complex solutions. By simplifying the complicated and offering digestible, scalable solutions, we can pay more attention to the things that matter most. Simplicity- it’s the word that inspired our name - we make cultivating health and vitality simple.
Do not be anxious about anything, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known to God.
Philippians 4:6
