We are the UAE's leading pickup football community platform, running weekly games across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, and Ajman. Over 30,000 app downloads, 60+ games weekly, and a growing community of players. We're expanding rapidly and building the content and marketing engine that will define our next phase of growth.

Role

This is a senior individual contributor role owning the full content, social media, and SEO function for Stranger Soccer UAE. You will take over an existing content operation (Instagram, video editing, community management) and expand it to include TikTok, Google SEO, and blog content. You'll work with a UAE-based videographer who shoots on-the-ground footage; you handle everything downstream — editing, design, captions, posting, community engagement, SEO, and analytics. This is a role for someone who can operate independently, think strategically about brand and growth, and produce high-volume quality content week after week.

Responsibilities

Content Production (~40% of time)

  • Video editing: produce short-form video content (Reels, TikToks, Stories, match highlights, promotional content) using CapCut Pro, Descript, or equivalent
  • Graphic design: create game announcements, event promos, sponsor content, and player-focused graphics using Canva Pro and AI-assisted tools
  • Copywriting: write post captions, community messages, event descriptions, and marketing copy in a consistent brand voice (AI-assisted via Claude/ChatGPT is fine — human editorial judgment required)
  • Coordinate with UAE videographer: provide weekly shot briefs, review raw footage, provide feedback, ensure quality standards

Social Media Management (~25% of time)

  • Instagram ownership: full management of the Stranger Soccer UAE Instagram account (feed, Reels, Stories, Highlights)
  • TikTok ownership: build our TikTok presence from current state to significant follower growth. Native TikTok content (not cross-posted Instagram), trend-driven, hook-first, minimum 4-5 posts per week
  • Facebook: maintain presence, cross-post where relevant
  • Content scheduling: manage weekly and monthly content calendar aligned with our games and marketing activations. Ensure Sunday content is pre-scheduled before your day off
  • Community management: respond to DMs, comments, and player queries with brand consistency and warmth
  • Analytics and reporting: monthly performance report covering follower growth, engagement rate, reach, saves, and content-driven bookings

Google SEO (~25% of time)

  • Own our organic search performance for high-intent UAE football keywords: "pickup football Dubai," "5-a-side Abu Dhabi," "football pitches Dubai," "join football game UAE," etc.
  • Keyword research and strategy: using Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console
  • On-page SEO: optimise our website pages for target keywords (titles, meta descriptions, headings, internal linking, schema markup)
  • Content-for-SEO: produce 2-4 SEO-optimised blog articles per month targeting UAE-specific football search intent (each 800-1,500 words, keyword-optimised, targeted at ranking)
  • Google Business Profile: manage and optimise our GBP presence, post weekly updates, drive review generation, respond to Q&A
  • Backlink building: identify partnership and outreach opportunities to build local domain authority
  • Monthly SEO report: track keyword rankings, organic traffic, top-performing content

Strategy and Growth (~10% of time)

  • Content calendar planning: monthly and weekly content plans built around our game schedule, campaigns, and community events
  • Campaign execution: plan and execute content around key moments (Ramadan football, National Day, Dubai Fitness Challenge 30x30, holiday activations, new venue launches, unlimited pass launch)
  • Competitor monitoring: track what competitors (CeleBreak and others) are doing across social and SEO — flag threats and opportunities
  • Player storytelling: identify community stories worth telling (long-tenure players, milestones, personal journeys) and produce content around them

Requirements

    • 3+ years in a social media or content role, ideally for a sports, fitness, hospitality, or community brand
    • 2+ years hands-on SEO experience — proven track record ranking content on Google, keyword research, on-page optimisation, content strategy
    • Proven portfolio of short-form video (Reels, TikToks) with measurable results
    • Proven graphic design work using Canva Pro or Adobe Suite
    • Working knowledge of SEO tools: Ahrefs, SEMrush, Google Search Console, Google Analytics
    • Fluent English, strong written communication, warm-yet-professional brand voice
    • Ability to work independently across UAE and PH time zones during the required working hours
    • Experience with a community-driven, subscription, or membership-model brand a PLUS
    • Personal interest in football or team sports a BIG PLUS
    • Familiarity with the UAE market, expat culture, or MENA region a PLUS
    • Experience with Google Ads or paid social a PLUS
    • Basic Arabic a PLUS
  • What Success Looks Like
    • By end of Month 1: Fully onboarded across IG, TikTok, website; October content calendar live; baseline SEO audit complete with 90-day plan; first 5+ native TikToks posted.
    • By end of Month 3: TikTok following grown by 500+; IG engagement up 15%+; 6-10 SEO blogs live; page 1 rankings for 2+ local keywords; smooth weekly rhythm with UAE videographer.
    • By end of Month 6: TikTok driving real traffic; top 5 ranking for 3-5 high-intent UAE football keywords; content planned 2+ weeks in advance; blog driving measurable bookings.

Other Details

  • 6 days per week (Monday to Saturday), 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM UAE time (2:00 PM to 10:00 PM Philippines time). Sundays off. Sunday content must be scheduled in advance to ensure uninterrupted publishing.
  • Virtual (Philippines-based, remote).

To Apply

Please submit the following in your Workable application (via cover letter) or via email to :

  • Full Portfolio Link: Samples of short-form video editing, graphic design, and written content.
  • Two Case Studies: Proven growth examples (follower growth, engagement rate, or SEO rankings) with specific performance numbers.
  • Intro Video: A 1–2 minute video explaining why you are the right fit for this role.

Senior Project Manager – Federal Projects


We are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead our federal construction projects portfolio. This role combines hands-on project management with team leadership, overseeing a dedicated group of Project Managers and Project Coordinators assigned to government contracts. The ideal candidate has deep experience navigating federal contracting requirements, managing construction projects from preconstruction through closeout, and directly supervising the construction management team, vendors, and subcontractors. Pay: $130,000 - $ 150,000

- Minimum 5 years of project management experience in construction, with significant experience on federal/government contracts
- Proven experience managing internal construction crews directly (not solely through subcontractors)
- Demonstrated experience negotiating and managing vendor and subcontractor relationships and contracts
- Working knowledge of federal contracting regulations (FAR/DFARS), prevailing wage requirements (Davis-Bacon Act), and government compliance/reporting standards

Preferred Qualifications

- Prior experience with a specific federal agency (e.g., GSA, VA, DoD, Army Corps of Engineers) — *customize based on your typical contracts*

- Familiarity with and federal procurement processes

Key Responsibilities

Project Management
- Own full project lifecycle management for federal construction projects, from award through closeout, ensuring scope, schedule, and budget targets are met
- Develop and maintain detailed project schedules, budgets, staffing plans, and risk registers
- Ensure full compliance with federal contracting requirements (e.g., FAR/DFARS, Davis-Bacon Act, EEO/Affirmative Action requirements, security clearance protocols as applicable)
- Prepare and submit required government documentation, including progress reports, RFIs, submittals, change orders, and closeout packages

Team Leadership

- Assign projects and workload across the team based on capacity, expertise, and contract requirements
- Establish and monitor performance standards, providing regular coaching, feedback, and professional development
- Conduct regular team meetings to review project status, resolve roadblocks, and align on priorities
- Support hiring, onboarding, and training of new PMs and coordinators as the federal team grows
- Foster a culture of accountability, compliance, and continuous improvement across the team

Field & Construction Oversight
- Oversee construction managers on federal job sites, including scheduling, productivity oversight, and performance management
- Source, negotiate with, and manage subcontractors and vendors, including contract administration and performance evaluation
- Conduct or oversee regular site visits to monitor progress, quality, and safety compliance
- Coordinate material procurement and logistics in alignment with project schedules
- Resolve field-level issues in real time, coordinating between office-based project teams and on-site personnel

Client & Stakeholder Relations
- Build and maintain strong relationships with federal agency representatives and other project stakeholders
- Represent the company in project meetings, site visits, and contract negotiations
- Proactively communicate project status, risks, and changes to internal leadership and external clients

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

- Primarily remote/home office based, with regular virtual collaboration with team members and stakeholders
- Periodic travel required to active project sites, which may include exposure to active construction environments
- Must be able to conduct site walks, including navigating uneven terrain, climbing stairs/ladders, and wearing required PPE during site visits

Anything else? Absolutely! Benefits and Perks:

Free Certifications: Who wants to be their best self? WE DO! As an ISSA team member, you have access to our courses and certifications…at no expense! Health & Wellness Reimbursement: If our company’s mission is to encourage healthy living, we need to walk the talk and ensure each employee is supported in their wellness journey! Parental Time Off: We support our team members as they grow their families! Eligible employees giving birth can receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave, while other parents welcoming a new child (including partners and adoptive/foster parents) receive up to 6 weeks of paid bonding leave.

Tools To Do The Job: We ensure you are hooked up with the tools, equipment, and systems you need. We begin the process before your start date, so you are ready to rock ‘n roll on your first day. We also provide a monthly work-from-home allowance!

SideBy Care is the first AI-supported virtual care service for GI practices and clients with Crohn's, colitis, and Disorders of Gut-Brain Interaction (DGBI).

Because the gut and brain constantly communicate through nerves, hormones, and chemicals, stress directly triggers GI symptoms (cramping, bloating, diarrhea), while gut issues simultaneously impact mood. We break this cycle by providing insurance-covered gut-brain therapy alongside diet and lifestyle support. Backed by scalable technology and behavioral science, more than 92% of our clients report quality of life and symptom improvement during the program.

Founded by individuals with lived experience, our purpose-built, personalized, and empathetic program delivers life-changing outcomes. jobs.excerpt: Sprout Social is looking to hire a Customer Success Manager, Key Accounts for the Sales & Customer Experience team.
jobs.description:
Sprout Social is looking to hire a Customer Success Manager, Key Accounts for the Sales & Customer Experience team.

Why join Sprout’s Sales & Customer Experience team?

The Sales and Customer Experience team shapes how Sprout powers the future of customer connection for today’s most innovative brands. We sell and support the leading social media management platform for businesses, helping organizations unlock the full value of social. Through powerful social intelligence and trusted partnership, we enable teams to build authentic relationships and drive meaningful business impact.

You’ll join a high-performing, collaborative team made up of some of the brightest minds in the industry, working with iconic brands like Campbell's, Salesforce, Airbnb, and Equifax. Just as importantly, Sprout is a place where your growth matters. You’ll have the freedom to shape your career, explore new paths, and build toward what’s next, with a team that’s invested in helping you get there.

What you’ll do

Own a book of ~60 Enterprise accounts — building relationships, driving adoption, and growing revenue within some of our largest, most strategic customers. The Customer Success Manager, Key Accounts plays a critical role in driving value through Sprout’s Social Intelligence platform.

  • Grow the relationship. Build strong, lasting relationships with key stakeholders — C-level executives, marketing directors, social media managers, and agency partners.

  • Bring a commercial mindset. Uncover new opportunities, qualify upsell and cross-sell leads, and confidently work through objections to expand accounts and defend revenue at renewal.

  • Run the cadence. Lead Mutual Success Plan reviews, monthly syncs, Executive Business Reviews, and adoption sessions to track usage, surface risks, and align on strategic goals.

  • Drive adoption. Partner with Onboarding and Professional Services to ramp new customers, and deliver ongoing training that keeps value visible throughout the client lifecycle.

  • Manage risk and retention. Spot churn risks early, resolve them proactively, and keep satisfaction high across your book. Collaborate effectively with Renewal Managers.

  • Tell the story with data. Track account health and key metrics, and turn them into a clear, compelling ROI narrative for customers and internally.

  • Work smart. Use generative AI tools like Claude and Gemini to speed up daily work — call prep, troubleshooting, drafting client messaging — so you can focus your time on the strategic parts of the job only you can own.

  • Hit your numbers. Consistently meet and exceed quota, managing your book against KPIs and your comp plan.

What you'll bring

Minimum qualifications:

  • 4-6 years in Customer Success, Account Management, or Sales in B2B SaaS, including 2+ years managing an Enterprise book of business.

  • Strong preference for candidates with prior account management or sales experience — comfortable qualifying leads, uncovering opportunity, and navigating objections in commercial conversations.

  • Demonstrated success retaining, renewing, and expanding Enterprise accounts through strategic relationship management.

  • Experience building relationships with, presenting to, and influencing senior decision-makers.

  • Familiarity with generative AI platforms (e.g., Claude, Gemini) and comfort integrating them into daily operations — call prep, troubleshooting, messaging — to work more efficiently, while retaining full ownership and leadership of strategic client engagements.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience advising on social media strategy or tools.

  • Experience working with or managing agency partners is a plus.

  • Familiarity with G-Suite, Salesforce, Gainsight and Tableau.

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Complete Sprout Social’s new hire training & onboarding program alongside other new Sprout team members. You’ll gain a broader understanding of our products and how your role fits into the organization.

  • Partner with the Manager of Customer Success to define key success metrics for your role and how you will measure against them.

  • Begin developing familiarity with our business, platform, and applications, as well as our company’s key metrics.

  • Acclimate yourself with the day to day responsibilities of Sprout’s Success Team by shadowing team members, listening to recorded customer calls and working closely with our dedicated Enablement Manager.

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Receive your dedicated book of business and begin familiarizing yourself with your customer base.

  • Establish relationships with customer-facing departments across the organization.

  • Direct customers to Sprout resources such as product guides, webinars, and customer support to encourage product adoption.

  • Respond to high-impact customer issues in a fashion that inspires continued customer loyalty.

  • Actively handle inbound requests and account related questions.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Maintain product expertise across our platform to serve as the ultimate trusted advisor.

  • Partner with colleagues across departments to address customer feedback and communicate accordingly.

  • Review to-date performance with your manager, identify areas of improvement and establish a plan for career development.

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Propose and execute independent projects benefiting the whole of Customer Success or Sprout as an organization.

  • Identify individual strengths and how to apply them effectively for continued success.

  • Master the Strategic Business Review and begin visiting customers in person to provide additional value.

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.

  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.

  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).

  • Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.

  • Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family.

  • Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.

  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.

  • Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations.

  • Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

Whenever possible, Sprout wants to provide our team with the flexibility to work in the location that makes the most sense for them. Sprout maintains a remote workforce in many places in the United States. However, we are not set up in all states, so please look at the drop-down box in our application to see whether your state is listed. Few roles require an office setting. If your position requires a physical presence in a Sprout office, it will be evident in the job listing and your offer letter.

Our salary ranges reflect the expected earning potential for this role. Individual pay is based on geographic zone, relevant experience, and skills.

Our current hiring range for this role: $92,000 - $115,000 OTE annually. OTE is governed by an incentive plan. It is the sum of a fixed base salary plus incentives at target performance. Incentive compensation will vary based on performance. Offers are made within this range, with opportunities to grow within the broader band based on performance and impact.

We share both our current hiring range and our broader geographic salary bands to provide transparency into our compensation philosophy. This ensures you understand not only your starting potential but also the long-term growth potential available as you progress in your role.

jobs.description:
Are you a problem-solver with a passion for automation and AI? At Synera, we’re looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who enjoys solving meaningful problems, collaborating with customers, and crafting innovative workflows that make a real impact. If you’re ready to help companies like NASA, BMW, and Airbus transform their engineering processes, keep reading!

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build workflows and multi-agent systems in Synera that show fast value to customers

  • Identify valuable next use cases with customers

  • Regularly visit customers (up to 40%)

  • Fill missing functionality with scripts, web node automations and custom add-ins

  • Optimize prompts of agents and multi-agent systems to make them reliable

  • Communicate closely with Synera product managers to bring temporary solutions into the product

What a week at Synera might look like:

  • Monday: You kick off the week with the Customer Success Manager (CSM) for your customer(s) to align on key priorities for the week.

  • Tuesday: You build a new workflow for the extraction of costing-relevant CAD data on example geometries.

  • Wednesday: You lead a workshop at one of your customers, working hands-on to incorporate the costing workflow into a multi-agent system on real data.

  • Thursday: You keep up to date with the developer teams in their sprint review meeting and give valuable user insights to the product managers. You finalize the workflow.

  • Friday: You join the knowledge exchange session with fellow FDEs and Solution Engineers.

Join our next team event and connect, relax, and have fun together with other Synerians!

🌱 WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?

We believe in transparent conversations about compensation from the start. For this role, our planned salary ranges are:

  • Intermediate Level: 63,200-78,800 EUR (OTE)

  • Experienced Level: 77,300-100,300 EUR (OTE)

OTE: total expected compensation if team performance targets are met, combining base salary and variable pay.

We determine the level we hire you for based on your experience, the scope of responsibilities you'll take on, and the impact you can drive. While we typically hire within these bands, we're open to some flexibility for candidates who bring exceptional value to the role.

Check out this page to learn how we approach salary, career growth, and creating an environment where everyone can shine.

What we offer beyond salary:

  • You're in the front row of an AI transformation - supporting a product that is actively changing how the world's top engineering teams work, not a commodity.

  • Flexible working: you decide when & where to work (as long as you have a residency in Germany).

  • Flexible public holidays: swap days off according to your values and beliefs!

  • Home office setup support + access to our office in Bremen.

  • Personal development budget of €2,000 to attend conferences and trainings or buy interesting books to improve in an area of your choice.

  • We don't count your vacation days, as we trust all our team members to decide what's best for them and the company.

  • To support your personal and professional well-being, we provide access to mental health platform nilo.

  • Regional meet-ups, virtual coffee breaks, and workshops. Plus, we come together as a whole company for our annual Summer Event! 🌈

Requirements

WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED

Even if you don't meet these criteria perfectly but believe you have lots to bring to the role, we encourage you to apply. We know it's tough, but please keep in mind that you don't have to match all the listed requirements exactly to be considered for this role.

  • You resonate with Synera's Core Values - they're central to how we work, and we'll explore them together in your first interview.

  • You have technical background in the Computational, Automation or Mechanical Engineering field.

  • You have proven experience (~1-3 years) in working with customers, demonstrating strong communication skills and the ability to showcase business value with technical solutions.

  • You have experience with CAD/CAE tools (e.g. OptiStruct, Siemens NX, CATIA, ANSYS, Nastran, Abaqus, LS-DYNA etc.).

  • You have experience and/or deep interest in AI (LLMs, prompt engineering, vibe coding).

  • You can juggle multiple priorities and thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • You enjoy collaborating with clients and explaining complex topics in a clear, engaging manner.

  • You are a native German speaker or have professional-level German proficiency, enabling you to communicate confidently and effectively with customers.

  • Customer Engagement: This role includes around 40% travel for customer visits, workshops, and on-site collaboration.

  • If you already have working experience with Synera and/or C# and Python coding it’s a plus 🍰

P.S. Synera is a place where everyone can grow, and every voice is valued. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day. We’re looking forward to learning how your perspective will bring something unique and valuable to our team 🌱

Why Synera?

We’re building the next generation of software for hardware - an Agentic AI platform that lets companies like Airbus, BMW, and NASA accelerate engineering work from days to hours. Our customers use Synera to automate everything from CAD and simulation workflows to design-for-manufacturing checks and RFQ prep - without needing to write code from scratch.

Think of us as doing for engineering what the advent of CAD did decades ago: enabling a whole new way of working. As PLM, CAD and CAE tools open up APIs, Synera gives teams the ability to build scalable, AI-augmented workflows that link these tools together. We're not just streamlining old processes—we're helping engineers hand off repetitive work to automation and AI agents that understand their domain.

If you’re a solutions engineer who’s automated design or simulation processes, glued together tools with Python and felt the frustration of being the only one who could, Synera is the next step. Join us at the leading edge.

The Opportunity

MedMe powers more than 70% of Canada's national pharmacy chains and roughly 40% of all community pharmacies. We are now building that same presence in the US, with pharmacies live in 15 states and expanding rapidly.

Much of that growth runs through partnerships with state pharmacy associations and buying groups, which give us a direct channel to their members. You'll be selling into pharmacies that already have a reason to talk to us, across our core platform, billing, and AI products.

This is a high-volume sales role with fast cycles. Most of the selling happens remotely, over calls and demos, though you should be willing to get in front of pharmacy owners in person when that's what it takes to close.

You'll also be the voice of the customer inside the business. As you spend time with pharmacists, you'll bring their feedback back to our product team to help us continuously enhance our products.

About MedMe Health

At MedMe, we are passionate about empowering pharmacists to provide services beyond just prescribing. Our mission is to build an all-in-one cloud-based platform that enables pharmacists to schedule, document, and manage clinical services at scale. With over 4,500 pharmacies using our software, we've facilitated more than 25 million patient services, transforming pharmacies into community health hubs across North America.

What You'll Do

  • Sell MedMe's core platform, billing, and AI products into independent and small-chain pharmacies across the US

  • Work closely with our partners, running the deals that come through partner channels

  • Run expansion sales into pharmacies already live on MedMe, growing adoption across our products

  • Manage a high volume of concurrent deals and keep them moving

  • Build direct relationships with pharmacy owners and operators

  • Bring the voice of the customer back to our product and AI teams, feeding real pharmacist input into what we build and improve next

About Us
Original Composites and Fibers is a global leader in glass reinforcement solutions for the composites industry. Recently separated from Owens Corning, the business now operates independently under the Praana ownership model, continuing a strong legacy of innovation, manufacturing excellence, and customer partnership.

With more than 4,000 employees worldwide, we are committed to redefining what's possible through a performance-driven culture centered on safety, quality, sustainability, inclusiveness, and employee development. Guided by our values of passion, ownership, and team spirit, we work together to deliver innovative solutions and exceptional service across the globe.

About the Role
We are seeking an SAP Basis Team Leader to lead the technical administration, operations, security, integration, and lifecycle management of our SAP landscape, including SAP S/4HANA Cloud, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Cloud Identity Services, SAP Commerce Cloud, SAP Cloud ALM, and related SAP business applications. This role will ensure SAP environments are secure, stable, scalable, integrated, and ready to support global business operations.

This position will lead the SAP Basis function and serve as a key technical partner to ERP, infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, application, and business teams. The role will coordinate with SAP, implementation partners, managed service providers, and internal IT teams to manage environments, transports, monitoring, releases, integrations, identity services, technical cutover, and operational readiness.

Original Composites & Fiberglass is a business unit of the Praana Group. Original Composites & Fiberglass was recently acquired by the Praana Group. The path ahead will be dynamic, full of change, and expected to be fast paced. The business operates from twenty (20+) locations across the globe. The information technology environment supporting our new company is being built from the ground up in terms of IT infrastructure and applications with the opportunity to leverage new technologies and new ways of thinking as we look to end a transition services agreement associated with the acquisition as soon as possible. Our Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) landscape is comprised of multiple instances across the globe. We seek to consolidate and simplify our ERP landscape to drive efficiency and effectiveness in our operations for decades ahead.

All IT team members may be assigned IT Engineering responsibilities, focused on designing, building, and maintaining technology systems that support business operations. These assignments ensure secure connectivity, scalable platforms, and reliable data flow to enable efficient production, supply chain management, and enterprise-wide digital transformation, especially during the separation from Owens Corning. Roles may be temporary or ongoing and can include direct ownership of IT service delivery for one or more manufacturing plants.

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the SAP Basis team, contract and internal resources, responsible for technical operations, platform governance, and support across the SAP landscape
  • Oversee administration and support of SAP S/4HANA Cloud, SAP BTP, SAP Cloud Identity Services, SAP Commerce Cloud, SAP Cloud ALM, SAP Signavio, SAP GRC, and related SAP solutions
  • Ensure availability, reliability, performance, and security of SAP development, test, quality, training, pre-production, and production environments
  • Coordinate SAP cloud tenant provisioning, system refreshes, maintenance events, release schedules, patching, and upgrade readiness activities with SAP and service providers
  • Define and govern SAP transport, release, and change management processes, including transport sequencing, deployment controls, cutover planning, and production release support
  • Lead SAP identity and access technical enablement, including SSO, SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS/IPS), Microsoft Entra ID integration, technical users, certificates, and authentication policies
  • Partner with SAP Security, IAM, cybersecurity, and application teams to support secure role deployment, privileged access, audit readiness, and access governance requirements
  • Oversee SAP integration administration, including connectivity, API enablement, middleware coordination, certificates, RFC/OData/REST/SOAP/IDoc interfaces, and issue resolution across SAP and non-SAP systems
  • Lead monitoring and operational readiness capabilities using SAP Cloud ALM and related tools, including job monitoring, interface monitoring, alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis
  • Support SAP Commerce Cloud technical operations, including environment management, deployments, configuration coordination, monitoring, integration support, and release readiness
  • Provide technical leadership for SAP implementation and transformation activities across SAP Activate phases, including environment readiness, testing support, data migration support, cutover execution, and hypercare
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, network, security, application, and business teams to design and operate secure, scalable, and reliable SAP platform services
  • Manage Basis work assigned to internal resources, implementation partners, and managed service providers, including priorities, deliverables, service levels, and issue escalation
  • Develop and maintain SAP technical standards, operational procedures, runbooks, support models, and knowledge transfer documentation
  • IT Engineering (As Assigned)
  • Own IT service delivery for assigned manufacturing sites, maintaining strong relationships and ensuring operational excellence
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver IT services aligned with business needs during organizational transitions, including separation activities
  • Participate in the design and implementation of secure, scalable, and reliable technology solutions that support core business operations and digital transformation
  • Ensure manufacturing connectivity and data flow across enterprise systems, enabling efficient production and supply chain processes
Qualifications & Requirements
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 8+ years of SAP Basis, SAP technical administration, or SAP platform operations experience in enterprise environments
  • 3+ years of team leadership, workstream leadership, or technical lead experience
  • Experience supporting SAP S/4HANA, preferably SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition or RISE with SAP
  • Experience with SAP system landscapes, client/tenant management, transport management, release coordination, and production support processes
  • Experience with SAP cloud solutions such as SAP BTP, SAP Cloud ALM, SAP Cloud Identity Services (IAS/IPS), SAP Signavio, SAP GRC, SAP Business AI, and SAP Commerce Cloud is preferred
  • Experience integrating SAP environments with Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, identity provisioning, and enterprise IAM platforms
  • Strong understanding of SAP security concepts, technical users, authorization dependencies, certificates, connectivity, and segregation of duties considerations
  • Experience supporting SAP integrations through middleware, APIs, RFC, OData, REST, SOAP, IDocs, and related connectivity patterns
  • Experience with SAP monitoring, job scheduling, interface monitoring, incident management, root-cause analysis, and performance troubleshooting
  • Experience with cloud operations, managed services, vendor governance, and coordination with SAP support organizations
  • Experience supporting large-scale ERP transformation, carve-out, acquisition, or TSA exit programs is preferred
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to operate independently in complex, fast-paced environments
  • Proven ability to influence stakeholders and guide cross-functional teams, including business leaders, IT teams, implementation partners, and vendors
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to translate technical issues, risks, and decisions into business-aligned outcomes
Work Conditions

jobs.description:
Description

Sprout Social is looking to hire a Director, Engineering - Artificial Intelligence to join our engineering team. This leader will report to the Senior Vice President, Engineering. The key focus of this role is to help build and execute our platform-wide AI strategy. As a member of Sprout’s Engineering leadership team, this leader will also facilitate strong collaboration across the engineering, product management and product design organizations.

Why join Sprout’s Engineering team?

Sprout empowers businesses worldwide to harness the immense power and opportunity of social media in today’s digital-first world. Processing over one billion social messages daily, our platform serves up essential insights and actionable information to over 30,000 brands, informing strategic decisions that drive business growth and innovation, and fostering deeper, authentic connections to their end customers. Our full suite of social media management solutions includes comprehensive publishing and engagement functionality, customer care solutions, influencer marketing, connected workflows, and business intelligence. We're actively working to intuitively weave AI throughout our products, enabling organizations to work smarter, unleash their creativity, and maximize the business impact of social media–that’s where you come in!

With collaborative, cross-functional teams spanning front-end, back-end, applied science, and ML Ops, our team is a place to sharpen your craft and solve hard problems alongside some of the smartest people in the industry. As a Director of Engineering, you’ll operate at “tech-giant” scale, leading engineers and technical leaders while partnering closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and other teams to shape strategy and deliver against a shared roadmap. You’ll provide leadership across architecture, system design, engineering execution, and talent development, while helping define how our products, platforms, and services interconnect and scale. You’ll also join an empathetic Engineering Leadership team committed to helping each other grow, raising the bar for engineering excellence, and supporting our teams in delivering world-class products.

What you’ll do

  • As a Director, you will be a key member of the AI leadership team and be responsible for building high-functioning teams of applied AI/ML scientists and engineers and steering them to iteratively deliver quality results.
  • You’ll lead the engineering team building foundational AI/ML products that will be used across our entire product suite and customer base.
  • You will partner closely with the VP, Engineering and your leaders to chart the strategic growth of the current team, defining and building new teams and helping to steer architecture and product direction.
  • Relying on your experience in building and maintaining highly scalable, reliable, distributed AI products and leading applied science teams, you'll lead teams to iteratively deliver quality software.
  • You will guide the team through complicated product and technical roadmaps, and partner with product management and design to align on the strategy for your teams and support its execution.
  • You’ll grow your team of engineers and applied scientists by example with effective feedback, coaching, and career development.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for a collaborative, pragmatic, highly motivating Engineering leader to help our AI team succeed and invest in the right capabilities to improve our customer experience and impact through AI and machine learning. If you confidently lead teams to solve hard problems, push them to learn from and teach each other, and work across functions and teams to get your teams to deliver, we'd love to talk with you!

The minimum qualifications for this role include:

  • 7+ years of experience building and supporting products in a production environment
  • 7+ years in software development, including several years leading teams and managing through leaders, with a track record of building sustainable, high-performing team structure.
  • Experience leading engineering teams building AI/ML or agentic products, including partnering with or leading applied scientists and AI/ML engineers.
  • Recent, direct experience (typically the last 2-3 years) leading or closely driving the development of modern AI products, agentic or LLM-based systems, evaluation and quality, built on foundation models. We care more about the depth and recency of your AI-product experience than the number of years.

Preferred qualifications for this role include:

  • Direct experience leading a mixed team of applied scientists and AI/ML engineers, and an understanding of how to lead research-inflected work, evaluation, model judgment, and quality, alongside product engineering.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and scaling high-performance teams through hiring and coaching of engineering leaders, applied scientists, and AI/ML engineers
  • Experience at a SaaS or product company that made a meaningful AI pivot or shift in product direction.
  • Experience aligning a team's focus and vision towards the most impactful work across a complex product suite to meet the needs of a diverse, global customer base
  • Track record of influencing and aligning stakeholders across different points of view or functions, to drive successful outcomes
  • Experience developing enterprise-level distributed applications using Python, Java, distributed queuing systems, etc.
  • Experience developing systems to deploy, manage, evaluate, and serve machine learning models and agentic products at scale
  • Experience with generative AI, including open source and third party solutions (e.g., OpenAI)

How you’ll grow

Within 1 month, you’ll plant your roots, including:

  • Experiencing Sprout’s in-depth onboarding, covering everything from our company mission and values, hearing directly from executives and founders, to deep training on our products and the value that Sprout delivers to our customers
  • Learning the current state of AI and machine learning at Sprout and future product and technical roadmaps
  • Meeting your team in 1:1s to understand what’s working, what’s not, and gathering learnings to implement into your role
  • Establishing relationships with other engineering, product and design leaders and identify areas of opportunity

Within 3 months, you’ll start hitting your stride by:

  • Participating in architectural discussions and decisions, bringing an informed industry perspective to ask the right questions and guide your team toward successful outcomes
  • Assuming management of the AI team's engineering leaders. Meeting with them regularly and providing them with direct, constructive feedback on their work, as well as formulating career growth plans
  • Participating in quarterly planning and roadmap processes and helping your team shape the technical roadmap for long-term success
  • Getting acclimated to the hiring process and partner with your leaders to establish a staffing plan and process for the teams
  • Helping your team and leaders improve processes and team rituals
  • Building relationships with our infrastructure, product, go to market, legal, and support teams and identify ways your teams can be more proactive and effective.

Within 6 months, you’ll be making a clear impact through:

  • Guiding and proactively evaluating your team’s execution on a major feature launch.
  • Understanding the business goals and helping the team proactively focus on the right problems while balancing technical debt, bugs, and product features with measurable results
  • Leading the performance review and career band calibration process for your team and coach your leaders through performance conversations with their direct reports
  • Partnering with the VP, Engineering, product and design teams to evangelize our AI and ML technical and product vision with internal and external stakeholders
  • Becoming an expert in our approach to AI and to confidently speak to ever-changing trends, new product features and platform enhancements to internal and external stakeholders

Within 12 months, you’ll make this role your own by:

  • Continue to develop your team, both personally and professionally, and having development plans in place for your team to hold them accountable
  • Serving as Sprout's bridge to the broader AI/ML industry by staying current on emerging trends and technologies and proactively bringing that outside perspective into the team's strategy and roadmap
  • Being recognized as a subject matter expert and leader in artificial intelligence and machine learning at Sprout
  • Surprise us! Use your unique ideas and abilities to change our AI capabilities in Sprout in beneficial ways that we haven’t even considered yet

Of course what is outlined above is the ideal timeline, but things may shift based on business needs and other projects and tasks could be added at the discretion of your manager.

Our Benefits Program

We’re proud to regularly be recognized for our team, product, and culture. We invest in our team with a comprehensive, competitive benefits program:

  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness: Premium BCBSIL medical, dental (high/low plans), and vision (Eyemed) insurance for you and your eligible dependents.
  • Premium Mental Health Support: Full, free access to Modern Health for you and your dependents, including coaching, therapy sessions, and digital wellness resources.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) plan with a 50% company match on your first 6% of contributions (a 3% total match).
  • Financial Security: 100% employer-paid Life and Disability insurance for your peace of mind.
  • Flexible Paid Time Off: A flexible PTO policy, supplemented with additional company-wide Rest & Recharge days throughout the year.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Up to 16 weeks of paid leave for new parents to support you in expanding your family.
  • Annual Lifestyle Stipend: A $1,000 USD annual Lifestyle Spending Account to spend on your physical, mental, and financial well-being.
  • Work From Home Support: A one-time $550 USD stipend to set up your home office, plus a monthly $50 USD stipend for internet.
  • Giving Back: 16 hours of paid volunteer time annually, plus a $100 annual match for your charitable donations.
  • Additional Financial Perks: Access to pre-tax commuter benefits, subsidized child/eldercare (Care.com), discounted pet insurance (Figo), and no-cost personalized financial wellness support through Your Money Line.

*This list is for informational purposes only. Benefit offerings are discretionary and subject to change and do not constitute a contract or guarantee of benefits.

However, we are not set up in all states, so please look at the drop-down box in our application to see whether your state is listed. Few roles require an office setting. About us

Founded in 1996, Argos Multilingual is a global provider of technology-enabled language, AI and data solutions. We combine human expertise, technology and AI to help organisations communicate, operate and grow across markets.

We work with some of the world’s most recognised companies, from global technology leaders and e-commerce innovators to major organisations in life sciences and manufacturing.

We are an international organisation with 400+ people across 42 countries. We continue to expand our capabilities in AI and data alongside our established language and localisation expertise, building on a strong foundation while embracing the opportunities created by new technology.

About the role

As an HR Generalist, you'll play a key role in delivering a high-quality HR experience across our global organisation. Our People team is a respected and valued strategic partner to the business. Our role is to enable performance across the organisation and create an environment where our people can thrive.

This is an individual contributor role with significant autonomy. You'll deliver day-to-day HR support across the full employee lifecycle, provide trusted advice to managers and employees, support recruitment and bring your experience and judgement to more complex people

matters.

Our workforce currently spans 42 countries, so you'll be comfortable navigating different employment environments, cultures and ways of working. You'll help us deliver effective HR across a complex global organisation, while bringing your experience and judgement to how we evolve the function.

You'll be joining at a time when Argos is continuing to grow and evolve. As we expand our data business and embrace new opportunities through AI, we're also evolving our People function to ensure our HR approach keeps pace with the needs of the business.

We're looking for an experienced HR professional who can operate with autonomy and make an immediate contribution. You'll bring demonstrable experience at this level, sound judgement and the confidence to handle complex people matters independently. We value people who are curious, challenge the status quo and want to improve how HR is delivered. You'll have the opportunity to use your experience to make a visible impact and help shape how the People function evolves.

You'll report directly to the Senior Vice President (Head of HR), becoming the sixth member of our People team.

What you'll do

HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle

  • Support the full lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding.
  • Act as trusted first point of contact for managers and employees.
  • Keep HR processes, records and HRIS data accurate and compliant.
  • Support payroll, benefits and external providers.
  • Manage HR documentation, contracts and employee communications.

Recruitment

  • Run end-to-end recruitment for agreed roles, from briefing and advertising to offer.
  • Partner with hiring managers on requirements, selection and decisions.
  • Manage sourcing, pipelines and candidate experience.
  • Work with external partners where specialist expertise is needed.
  • Improve recruitment processes with technology and AI.

Employee Relations

  • Provide practical advice on performance, absence, conduct and other matters.
  • Independently handle complex Employee Relations cases including disciplinary, grievance, absence, performance and workplace investigations.
  • Ensure decisions are fair, consistent, policy-aligned and compliant.
  • Know when to seek local or specialist advice and escalate appropriately.

Performance, Policies & Continuous Improvement

  • Support performance management, development and employee experience initiatives with the HR Business Partner and L&D team.
  • Help develop and implement HR policies that reflect applicable employment requirements.
  • Work effectively across our locations, drawing on local expertise.
  • Simplify and automate HR processes and contribute to our evolving use of HR technology and AI.
  • Contribute to projects that improve employee experience, efficiency and scalability.

Who you are

Solutions-driven, self-directed and comfortable with autonomy, collaborative, pragmatic in balancing business needs with good HR practice, and curious about how AI and technology can change the way HR is delivered.

Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years' HR experience with hands-on work across the full employee lifecycle.
  • Strong end-to-end recruitment experience.
  • Strong practical knowledge of employment law and HR compliance across different employment environments, seeking local advice where required.
  • Demonstrable experience independently managing complex employee relations matters (disciplinary, grievance, performance, absence, investigations).
  • Proven ability to advise and coach managers on a broad range of people matters.
  • Experience developing and improving HR policies, processes and systems with practical, scalable solutions.
  • Experience working effectively in a remote, globally distributed organisation.
  • Genuine interest in HR technology, automation and AI.

Why join us?

You'll join at an important point in our growth and transformation. We have almost 30 years of experience and an established global client base, but we're not interested in simply maintaining what we've built.

AI, data and technology are reshaping our industry, and we're responding by investing in new capabilities and new ways of working.

You'll work with colleagues across countries, cultures and time zones on work with genuinely international reach, with the scale and stability of an established global business plus real influence over how we operate and where we go next.

About Sezzle:


With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. About the Role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Fraud Data Analyst to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for uncovering fraudulent activities and a strong understanding of fraud prevention strategies. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, investigating, and preventing fraudulent transactions and activities, utilizing your analytical skills and experience with SQL to query and analyze data. You will play a crucial role in protecting our company and our customers from financial loss and reputational damage.
Due to the requirements of the position, only English resumes will be accepted.

What You'll Do:
  • Monitor transactions and customer accounts to identify and investigate suspicious or fraudulent activity.
  • Utilize various fraud detection tools, systems, and techniques to identify emerging fraud trends and patterns.
  • Conduct in-depth investigations into suspected fraudulent activities, gathering evidence and documenting findings.
  • Analyze large datasets using SQL to identify anomalies, patterns, and insights related to fraudulent behavior.
  • Develop and implement fraud prevention rules, strategies, and controls.
  • Stay up to date with industry best practices, emerging fraud threats, and new technologies in fraud detection and prevention.

What We Look For:

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g. Economics, Computer Science, Analytics, or a related field).
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience in a fraud detection, prevention, or investigation role.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience working with SQL and Python.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.
  • Understanding of common fraud typologies (e.g., account takeover, identity theft, payment fraud, etc.).
  • Experience with fraud detection tools and platforms is a plus.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex issues.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • High level of integrity and a commitment to ethical practices
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Work experience in fintech, payments, lending, banking, or financial institutions is a plus
  • Degree in statistics, math, finance, economics, or related quantitative discipline; graduate degree a plus

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:


At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Our client, a premier, vertically integrated commercial real estate (CRE) firm headquartered in Irvine, California, managing approximately $4 billion in assets. Their portfolio encompasses around 100 high-value retail properties across the United States, servicing nearly 1,000 commercial tenants.

The Marketing & Leasing Coordinator owns how the firm presents its commercial real estate portfolio and brokerage offerings to the market. Primary focus areas include maintaining property website content, creating high-end marketing collateral, managing online listing platforms, and driving scheduled outreach cadences.

This is a public-facing position operating exclusively with publicly marketable property data. This role does not require access to or handling of sensitive financial or legal data. The ideal candidate brings commercial real estate design standards, high attention to detail, strong spoken and written English, and hands-on experience using web and design tools to maintain a polished brand presence.


Key Responsibilities

Property Marketing & Collateral Development (~50%)

  • Collateral Creation: Build and update property flyers, leasing brochures, availability sheets, site plans, and presentation decks using brand standards.
  • Brand & Content Freshness: Ensure every flyer in circulation is accurate, visually appealing, and updated within a 90-day cycle.

  • Outreach Campaigns: Draft property email blasts, broker announcements, and social media content (e.g., LinkedIn) using pre-approved templates and content.

Website & Digital Presence (~25%)

  • Website Management: Update property pages on the company website with photos, site plans, square footages, availability statuses, and contact details.
  • Rapid Turnaround: Publish new availability and remove leased suites within one business day of notification.
  • Site Quality & Analytics: Perform monthly audits for broken links, outdated collateral, or stale data. Track basic site analytics, reporting monthly on traffic and inquiry volume.
  • Web Enhancements: Collaborate on basic website improvements using CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress, Squarespace, Webflow) and AI/development tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub).

Listing Platform Management (~15%)

  • Platform Ownership: Maintain active property listings across CoStar, Crexi, LoopNet, and other commercial real estate listing platforms.
  • Listing Audits: Reconcile all external listings against master availability lists monthly to ensure 100% accuracy in photos, square footage, and property descriptions.
  • Market Surveys & Performance: Track listing views, saves, and inquiries per property each month, maintaining a log of published market asking rates.

Leasing Coordination Support (~10%)

  • Inquiry Intake & Logging: Log every incoming broker and prospect inquiry same-day (source, property, square footage, intended use, contact details).
  • First-Touch Responses: Acknowledge inbound inquiries using standard approved templates and route them to the internal leasing team.

.

jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Director of Development Engineering to join our team.

Position Description

The Director of Development Engineering oversees all civil, site, and nuclear engineering activities required to advance Aurora powerhouse sites through development and into construction readiness. Your team produces the technical deliverables — site layouts, basis-of-design packages, geotechnical and environmental assessments, and engineering inputs to permitting — that underpin state/local approvals and NRC licensing (coordinated with Oklo's Environmental & Permitting team), project financing, and construction handoff. Environmental & Permitting and Project Finance are coordinated with Oklo's dedicated teams.

Specific responsibilities may include:

  • Lead development engineering across all active sites: site layout, civil/grading design, geotechnical investigation, hydrology, and infrastructure planning
  • Solutions engineering for potential co-located buildings such as advanced manufacturing and data centers
  • Produce basis-of-design documentation sufficient for project finance due diligence and EPC handoff
  • Manage third-party engineering consultants and coordinate with Oklo's internal nuclear design team
  • Provide engineering inputs to NRC licensing and NEPA processes coordinated by Oklo's Environmental & Permitting team
  • Develop and maintain engineering standards, templates, and quality protocols for the Development organization
  • Partner with Oklo’s New Product Integration (NPI) team to translate reactor design requirements, siting criteria, and product evolution into site-specific technical constraints and development scope — ensuring early alignment between product design and site realities
  • Develop and own site constraints packages for each Aurora powerhouse development site, synthesizing geotechnical, hydrological, environmental, grid, and regulatory inputs into a single authoritative technical baseline that governs site selection, design, and permitting decisions
  • Integrate and quality-control deliverables from civil, geotechnical, environmental, and nuclear engineering consultants — ensuring all third-party work products are consistent, current, and accurately reflected in the site constraints package and project schedule
  • Own the development engineering schedule and provide cross-functional technical leadership to identify, prioritize, and mitigate technical risks and fatal flaws on project sites — coordinating with Project Development, Transmission & Interconnection, and Oklo’s Environmental & Permitting team to surface issues early and preserve development optionality
  • Lead structured technical risk reviews at each stage gate, evaluating site constraints packages against go/no-go criteria and escalating unresolved fatal flaw risks to the VP of Development with clear options analysis and recommended disposition
  • Build and manage a team of engineers across civil/site/electrical and nuclear development disciplines
  • Provide engineering support for Isotope production facilities, including facility layout, utility infrastructure design, and integration with co-located Aurora powerhouse systems
  • Lead development engineering for Nuclear Lifecycle Innovation Campuses (NLICs), coordinating multi-use site design across power generation, isotope production, and research facility components

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 12+ years in energy, infrastructure, advanced manufacturing or data center project development engineering, with at least 5 years in a leadership role
  • Strong civil/site engineering background; nuclear project experience highly valued
  • Experience producing engineering deliverables for project financing and EPC handoff
  • PE license strongly preferred; experience with DOE or NRC-regulated facilities a significant advantage

Competencies

We are looking for a Director of Development Engineering that is:

  • Passionate about clean energy
  • Passionate about making advanced fission a reality
  • Willing and able to learn quickly
  • Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us
  • Willing to think differently and do things in new ways
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment
  • Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before
  • Willing to propose novel and creative solutions to technical problems
  • An excellent writer who can write in modern active voice, so make your cover letter compelling and write it well!
  • Able to communicate technical content and results verbally

Who you are:

A startup person: You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated: You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player: Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator: We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

Creative: Being creative means that when things fall outside clear scopes or processes or problems arise without clear solutions, you are able to identify it as well as invent ways to solve a problem or fill a need without micromanagement. The successful person in this job will not only be creative, but also enjoy being creative and solving open-ended problems which may change day-by-day.

Detail-oriented: This focus is a big part of excellence, consistency, and quality. Excellent grammar and spelling matter for both good communication as well as the image of the company that we put forward.

About Oklo travel requirements:

Oklo requires remote employees to travel to headquarters (Santa Clara, CA) twice a quarter annually, based on business or team needs, including attendance at team meetings, off-sites, and other company events or gatherings. For the first two weeks of onboarding, employees are required to be in person at headquarters in Santa Clara, CA.

About Oklo compensation:

Salary: $225,000-$275,000

Oklo offers flexible time off, equity, bonuses, competitive pay, 401(k), health insurance (with employer contribution), HSA, FSA, flexible work hours, wellness credits, and other benefits.

This position may involve access to information subject to U.S. export control laws. Only applicants who meet the definition of a U.S. person under applicable laws may be eligible.

About Oklo Inc.: Oklo Inc. is developing fast fission power plants to deliver clean, reliable, and affordable energy at scale; establishing a domestic supply chain for critical radioisotopes; and advancing nuclear fuel recycling to convert nuclear waste into clean energy. Oklo was the first to receive a site use permit from the U.S. Department of Energy for a commercial advanced fission plant, was awarded fuel material from Idaho National Laboratory, and submitted the first custom combined license application for an advanced reactor to the U.S. Nuclear Regulatory Commission. Oklo is also developing advanced fuel recycling technologies in collaboration with the U.S. Department of Energy and U.S. National Laboratories.

#CHOP: Oklo’s Values
Collaboration: We go further, together. We bring diverse perspectives, listen actively, and build trust through transparency and respect. We work across disciplines, sharing ownership to turn complex challenges into shared successes.
Humility: We are team players who act for the good of the company and for the world. We are focused on our mission, not personal recognition.
Ownership: We take pride in what we do and how we do it. We are proactive in finding solutions and see tasks through to completion. We are committed to delivering on our promises to provide clean, reliable, and affordable energy.
Pathfinding: We chart new ground where no path exists by approaching challenges with curiosity, courage, and creativity while navigating ambiguity.

Candidates should be aware that employment may be contingent upon successful completion of a drug screening, and employees may be subject to drug testing at any time in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.

Recruitment Fraud Disclaimer

Oklo is aware of recent recruitment fraud attempts targeting job seekers. Please be cautious of anyone claiming to represent Oklo who does not contact you from an official Oklo email address.

All legitimate communications from our recruiting team— including application updates, interview requests, and job offers — will come exclusively from an @oklo.com email. Oklo will never ask for sensitive personal information, payments, or account credentials during the hiring process.

If you receive suspicious outreach or have concerns about the authenticity of any communication claiming to be from Oklo, please contact us through the official channels listed on our website.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description A bit about this role: At Devoted, our mission is to dramatically improve the health and well-being of our members by treating each of them like family.
jobs.description:
Job Description

A bit about this role:

At Devoted, our mission is to dramatically improve the health and well-being of our members by treating each of them like family. Getting a member’s record right is part of that promise. When we carry the wrong primary payer, miss a hospice election, or have a stale address on file, the member feels it before it shows up in a report. Doing this work well is an important part of making sure members can rely on us for the care they need

We are seeking a leader to serve as the Director of Membership Status Operations. This role owns the member status conditions that determine what CMS and our state partners pay us once enrollment is complete,along with the reconciliation and controls that make those determinations reliable. The role pairs regulatory expertise with financial and operational discipline, managing these conditions as a dynamic portfolio in which an undetected or late determination can create downstream disruption for the member and keep us from delivering the seamless experience we expect.

Membership Operations has built real capability in reconciliation: confirming that every member we are responsible for is enrolled correctly and at the right effective date and rate given the information available at point of application. You will own the next stage of that work. Several of these areas are still immature, and your first job is to be honest about which ones and to build the durable, monitored, auditable operation they require. The objective is accuracy in both directions — payment that reflects the member’s true status, whether that means we are owed more or owe money back. You will directly engage with AI-enabled tools to optimize signal detection, document review, and investigation triage.

This is foundational work - and there is a meaningful opportunity for this leader to leave their fingerprints all over how we do it.

Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

Member Status Determinations

  • Own the end-to-end operation for each area: from identifying a potential issue, to investigating it, making the right determination, submitting any required updates, checking the work for accuracy, and making sure any follow-up action gets completed.

  • Manage these areas with clear daily and weekly checks so we catch important status changes as they happen, rather than finding them after the fact.

  • Take direct ownership of the workflows that are not yet mature, and prioritize improvements based on member impact, financial risk, and compliance risk - not just what is easiest to fix.

  • Keep the operation current with CMS technical guidance, including Medicare Secondary Payer rules, hospice and ESRD payment treatment, and county-based rate structures.

  • Maintain the policies that define what makes a suspect, what evidence substantiates a determination, and how it is documented, so any determination can be reproduced on demand for a CMS program audit, state review, or internal audit. Report accuracy misses that reduce revenue with the same rigor as those that increase it.

  • Use AI and other tools to make these workflows more efficient, including identifying potential issues earlier and reducing manual review where it makes sense.

  • Set, monitor, and enforce SLAs and KPIs across internal teams, offshore partners, and external vendors.

Reconciliation and Controls

  • Define and deliver the KPIs that measure the operation — detection coverage, open inventory aging, signal-to-determination cycle time, rework, retroactive adjustment rates — and make them visible in executive-facing dashboards alongside recovered and at-risk revenue and outstanding variances.

  • Run expected-vs-actual analysis to flag macro-level payment degradation early and direct remediation to the conditions driving it.

  • Convert manual detection and correction into documented, owned controls with defined thresholds, aging limits, and escalation paths, so the operation does not depend on individual heroics or tribal knowledge.

  • Partner with Data Science and Engineering to identify key measurement points and prioritize platform improvements, writing the business cases and holding delivery partners to committed outcomes.

  • Work closely with Finance, Actuarial, Risk Adjustment, Compliance, and Legal to make sure the work is accurate, well documented, and ready for review — and to help partners understand the impact of issues when they arise.

  • Build, develop, and retain the team, and bring an end-to-end perspective to policy and procedure decisions across Membership Operations.

Required skills and experience:

  • Proven operator with a track record of turning complex operational problems into scalable, practical business processes.

  • Demonstrated experience building operational controls where none existed, not only running a mature process at scale.

  • Proven ability to take new cross-functional initiatives from idea to launch across multiple stakeholder groups.

  • Able to digest intricate regulatory or technical guidance and translate it into determination criteria, evidence standards, and daily workflow.

  • Fluency working with data: you can specify requirements, interrogate a dataset, and challenge a number without waiting for analyst support.

  • High ethical standards and sound judgment under revenue pressure, including the willingness to surface and correct an error that goes against our financial interest.

  • Comfortable owning an ambitious goal in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment — you own the determinations, the standards, the controls, and the roadmap, and you build the case when the work needs new investment.

Desired skills and experience:

  • Experience managing multiple teams and vendors, including offshore partners.

  • Prior experience in Medicare Advantage, D-SNP, or integrated Medicare-Medicaid experience, including state file reconciliation and deeming administration.

  • Experience operating under CMS program audit or comparable regulatory examination.

  • Proven organizational, communication, and leadership skills.

Remote with onsite expectations multiple times per year.

Salary Range: $182,000-$216,000 / year

The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job.

Our Total Rewards package includes:

  • Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium

  • Generous paid time off

  • $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend

  • Stock options for all employees

  • Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles

  • Parental leave program

  • 401K program

  • And more....

*Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. Intern and Contract positions are not eligible.

Founded in 2017, Devoted Health is on a mission to dramatically improve the health and well-being of older Americans by caring for everyone like they are family, and that includes our employees. Our robust and seamlessly integrated care platform merges advanced data and AI access with world-class clinical and service experiences to create a member experience that is unlike the industry norm. To continue building upon our mission, we want to bring together those who share our values, embrace change and advancement, and are enthusiastic about where we're going — all the while bringing their own unique qualities, experiences, and expertise, in hopes of further changing the healthcare experience.


Devoted is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a safe and supportive work environment in which all employees have the opportunity to participate and contribute to the success of the business.
