  • Use AI-enabled writing and research tools throughout concepting, drafting, editing and iteration.

  • Use generative tools to expand exploration rather than simply increase the volume of copy.

  • Apply strong creative judgment to all AI-assisted writing.

  • Help define where AI can support speed and scale and where human authorship remains essential.

  • Test emerging Adobe capabilities through real creative work and share useful feedback with Product teams.

  • Apply responsible AI practices, including accuracy, authorship, provenance, creator rights and Content Credentials.

Collaborate and Deliver

  • Work closely with Designers, Art Directors, Motion teams, Strategists, Producers, Product and Product Marketing.

  • Present work clearly, explain creative choices, and respond constructively to feedback.

  • Partner with Production to ensure scripts and written ideas are executable without losing their creative intent.

  • Collaborate with agency and specialist copywriters when external expertise is required.

  • Maintain a high writing standard through fast timelines, multiple workstreams, and changing priorities.

  • Take ownership of your work while contributing generously to the ideas of others.

What You Need to Succeed

  • You consider yourself a maker first. AI fluency is how you work, not a skill you are developing.

  • 6+ years of experience in copywriting, creative writing, or related field.

  • A standout portfolio spanning campaigns, scripts, multi-platform storytelling, product narratives, or experiences.

  • Exceptional copywriting and creative judgment, with the ability to make language clearer, sharper, and more memorable.

  • The ability to move confidently between short-form and long-form writing.

  • Strong conceptual thinking and experience developing ideas alongside multidisciplinary creative teams.

  • Experience translating complex products or technologies into compelling human stories.

  • Experience writing for different platforms, audiences, and cultural contexts.

  • Familiarity with voice systems, messaging frameworks, naming, or verbal identity.

  • Fluency with AI-enabled writing tools and a clear perspective on how they support rather than replace human creativity.

  • Strong presentation, communication, and collaboration skills.

jobs.title: Design Team Lead - Ecommerce Marketing Agency
jobs.excerpt: The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team.
jobs.description:
The Design Team Lead runs the day to day work of our Design Team. There are two sides to it. One is craft, which means keeping the standard of the design work high across every client we serve. The other is people, which means keeping the team organised, supported, and able to do good work without getting stuck.

Most of what the team produces is email and SMS campaign design for ecommerce brands, along with ad images, GIFs, short video edits, and the occasional landing page. You will still design yourself, but the larger part of the job is making sure what goes out is right. You are the person who spots what is not working in a design before the client does, and who explains the fix in a way a designer can act on straight away.

You will work closely with Account Managers, who assign the day to day tasks, and with the designers who carry them out. A good deal of the role sits between those two groups: helping an Account Manager work out what a campaign actually needs, turning that into clear direction for a designer, and saying so when a request does not make sense.

The Design Team Lead reports to the Service Director, and works closely with the other departments at Hustler Marketing to make sure design work is delivered well and on time.

About the Role:Mission statement:

To keep the quality of our design work at a level clients notice, and to run a team that is organised, well briefed, and heard.
The first half of that is craft. Reviewing work, spotting what is weak in a design, and giving direction that makes it better. The second half is people. Distributing the week, reorganising it when something changes, and making sure the team's ideas and concerns reach someone who can act on them. We already have a strong team here, independent and reliable. What they need from a lead is someone who listens properly and comes back with a real answer.


General Responsibilities:

Design quality and direction

  • Reviewing the team's design work before it reaches Account Managers or clients, and giving feedback specific enough to act on
  • Diagnosing why a design is not working, whether that is hierarchy, contrast, the weight of the call to action, the balance of image to text, or how it holds up on mobile, and writing the fix down clearly
  • Advising Account Managers on what a campaign needs visually, and pushing back when a brief is thin or a request will not serve the client
  • Designing directly when the workload calls for it. This is a hands-on role, not a purely supervisory one
  • Keeping the work consistent across a wide range of client brands, niches, and visual identities
  • Setting and holding the design standards for email and SMS campaigns, ad images, GIFs, and short video assets
  • Understanding each client's visual brand identity well enough to advise on ideas, improvements, and optimisations

Running the week

  • Distributing and organising the team's workload week by week, working from the tasks Account Managers assign
  • Reorganising the queue quickly when priorities change, someone is unavailable, or a client adds something at the last minute
  • Keeping track of who is overloaded and who is not, and rebalancing before it turns into a missed deadline
  • Being the first person the Design Team comes to when something is blocking their work
  • Making sure the design targets set for each client account are met

The team

  • Running the Design Team's group calls and regular one-to-ones
  • Collecting the team's suggestions and concerns, taking them seriously, and coming back with an answer, including when the answer is no
  • Mentoring designers and helping the less experienced members build their skills
  • Onboarding new designers into how we work
  • Connecting Design with the other service teams through workshops, short tutorials, and written documentation
  • Running training and skill-building sessions for the Design Team

Process and improvement

  • Noticing where a workflow, a handoff, or a piece of communication is costing the team time, and fixing it
  • Writing and maintaining the documentation the team works from
  • Keeping up with what Figma ships and bringing the useful parts into how the team works
  • Staying current on design and email marketing trends, and sharing what matters rather than everything
  • Bringing industry best practices back to the Service Director and to the team

About Us

OpenFX is on a mission to move money as freely as data, unrestricted by time zones, banking hours, or legacy systems. We are building the infrastructure that will power the next generation of cross-border payment systems for institutions.

The team’s execution has been exceptional and we are scaling at a remarkable pace. Our early team brings experience from J.P. Morgan, Goldman Sachs, FalconX, PayPal, Affirm, Polygon, Kraken, Nium and others, and we are backed by Accel, Lightspeed, NFX and other top-tier investors.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Product Operations for Latin America to own how new currencies and corridors actually get to market across the region. Every currency we launch unlocks new corridors for our institutional clients and drives trading volume and revenue directly. Your mandate is to make that expansion happen on the ground: sourcing and onboarding liquidity providers, standing up settlement rails with banking partners, clearing jurisdiction-specific regulatory requirements, and holding every launch to the reliability bar our clients expect.

You will run the regional launch pipeline with real independence. You will own pricing inputs, sequencing and the go-live decision. You report to the Product Leader of Global Payments & Currencies, who sets strategic prioritisation for which currencies matter most based on payout corridor relevance. You own the how and the when.

If you have shipped cross-border payment products, worked with banking or card network infrastructure, or built API-driven financial products across jurisdictions, this role will feel familiar. The difference is that you will be doing it at the frontier of stablecoin-settled FX infrastructure, where the rails are new and the playbook is yours to write.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own corridor launch, end to end. You own every currency in your regional pipeline from Alpha through General Availability. You track liquidity partner onboarding, settlement rail readiness, regulatory clearance, operational setup and pricing. You run readiness reviews, maintain the launch checklist, and make the go/no-go call.
  • Operationalise our licences. Holding a licence and being able to use it are two different things. You work with Product Management, Legal and Regulatory, Compliance, Finance and Engineering to turn each licence, registration and partner permission into permitted product scope, documented operating procedures and live client flows. You keep what we are authorised to do and what we actually run in market in step, and you make sure new capability reaches clients as soon as the licence allows rather than months later.
  • Work directly with LPs and banking partners. You are the product voice in liquidity provider onboarding and banking partner discussions. You understand what it takes to stand up a new currency pair technically, what banking partners need in order to enable settlement, and how to translate partner constraints into product decisions.
  • Navigate multi-market regulatory complexity. Every currency carries jurisdiction-specific requirements. You work with Legal and Regulatory to establish what is needed, translate it into product and engineering decisions, and ensure no currency launches without clearance.
  • Prioritise engineering effort. You work with engineers to deliver against the roadmap. You write specs, set sprint priorities, and partner with your EM so capacity lands on the highest-impact currencies.
  • Drive post-launch adoption. A currency is not done at launch. You track whether clients are actually trading new corridors, partner with GTM to drive activation, find the friction, and feed what you learn back into prioritisation.
  • Build the regional launch playbook. You turn each launch into a repeatable, documented process covering every dependency, gate criterion and handoff, so the tenth currency is faster than the first.

What We Are Looking For

Must-haves

  • 8+ years in product management, product operations or programme management. You have owned a complex, multi-dependency delivery process in a B2B or infrastructure product.
  • Cross-border payments or financial infrastructure context. You have worked on payments, FX, card networks or digital asset products.
  • Multi-market experience. You have shipped products across multiple countries or regulatory jurisdictions.
  • Comfort operating between product, legal and compliance. You can read a regulatory requirement, work out what it means for a product flow, and drive it to a decision without waiting to be told.
  • Operational rigour. You maintain systems that track complex, multi-dependency work. You build the checklist, follow up on the open item, and catch the gap before it becomes a blocker.
  • Based in Brazil, in São Paulo or remote, and fluent in Portuguese and English.

What helps you stand out

  • LatAm corridor knowledge. Experience with Brazilian and wider LatAm payment rails, regulatory environments or banking partner ecosystems. Spanish is a plus alongside Portuguese.
  • Licensing and regulatory delivery. You have helped operationalise a licence, registration or scheme membership, not just tracked one.
  • Card network or payment scheme background. Time at a card network, payment scheme or large-scale processor with multi-market product launches.
  • Stablecoin or digital asset rails. Familiarity with stablecoin settlement, on and off-ramp infrastructure, or crypto payment products.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package
  • Equity in a rapidly growing company
  • The chance to work in a fast-paced startup at the forefront of fintech innovation
  • Real impact on global financial infrastructure
  • A collaborative culture with genuine emphasis on personal and professional growth

    • Maintain accurate administrative records and trackers in Excel/Google Sheets, ensuring data quality, status updates, and organized documentation throughout the audit process.
  • Outcome 3: Audit Automation & Dashboards
    • Actively participate in the Audit Automation Project to streamline operations using modern technology and AI workflows.
    • Develop and maintain Audit Dashboards to monitor overall audit performance, track bottlenecks, and provide actionable financial data insights to key stakeholders.

Must-have experience

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Customer Service, Client Support, Operations Support, or a Coordination role (Prior formal Audit experience is not required).
  • Proven experience in client-facing written and verbal communication (email, calls, messaging platforms), particularly around handling client onboarding and managing unresponsive accounts.
  • Demonstrated capability in managing multiple stakeholders and tracking tasks simultaneously.
  • Strong hands-on proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, tracking tools, and reporting.
  • Experience or strong comfort with financial analysis and reporting metrics.
  • Practical experience or strong interest in using AI tools and IT applications to automate daily administrative workflows.
  • Candidates must be based in the Philippines.

Must-have attributes

  • Ownership & Accountability: Takes full accountability for client accounts and administrative trackers; follows through on tasks without constant supervision and proactively resolves roadblocks.
  • Structured Thinking & Attention to Detail: Organizes complex, multi-stream audit tasklists effectively, maintaining high data accuracy and catching missing or inconsistent documentation early.
  • Communication Clarity & Active Listening: Communicates clearly, professionally, and empathetically across global teams and clients where English may be a second language.
  • AI & Tech Savvy: Energetic about adopting new software, AI tools, and IT applications to increase task efficiency and streamline audit reporting.
  • Humility & Adaptability: Open to feedback, eager to learn evolving audit workflows, and comfortable collaborating across diverse international teams.

Behavioural fit is also important at Sleek, and we will be looking for candidates that have a proven track record of embodying the below attributes in their recent roles:

  • Ownership: This shows reliability and helps build trust within the team. We move fast and need to know that everyone will see things through to completion and proactively help to get things back on track when challenges arise. Accountability is really important to us.
  • Humility: There is so much we don’t know. Humility allows for open-mindedness to feedback and a willingness to learn from others. It paves the way for collaboration and creates a positive work environment. It is a key ingredient of self awareness and emotional intelligence.
  • Structured Thinking: Our business is complex with many layers (many services, many countries, many cultures). Regardless of whether you’re more analytical or creative in nature, being able to show sound judgement is important to us. It ensures solutions are pragmatic and balance the needs of the organisation, team and customers.
  • Attention to detail: You’ll be managing multiple, complex workstreams from numerous stakeholders. It will be important for you to keep track of everything and notice when information is missing or inconsistent.
  • Excellent listener and clear communicator: We have a variety of nationalities and for many people, English isn’t their first language. For you to excel, you’ll need to be present in your calls and make sure you properly receive and thoughtfully send messages to others in the business.

The interview process The successful candidate will participate in the following interview stages. We anticipate the process to last no more than 3 weeks from start to finish.

  • One-way Video Interview: Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview to assess written/spoken communication and initial background.
  • Technical Round: A 30-minute chat with the Hiring Team to assess core technical skills, followed by a 30-minute interview with the Audit Partner to dive into your client onboarding, coordination and tracking experience.
  • Soft Skills Round: A 30-minute to 60-minute chat with a member of the leadership team to evaluate real-world work scenarios against our core behavioral values.
  • Reference Verification: Prior to final offer confirmation, we will conduct professional reference checks with your recent direct manager or supervisor.

Requirement for background screening Please be aware that Sleek is a regulated entity and as such is required to perform different levels of background checks on staff depending on their role. This may include using external vendors to verify:

  • Your education
  • Any criminal history
  • Any political exposure
  • Any bankruptcy or adverse credit history We will ask for your consent before conducting these checks. Depending on your role at Sleek, an adverse result on one of these checks may prohibit you from passing probation. By submitting a job application, you confirm that you have read and agree to our Data Privacy Statement for Candidates, found at Sleek.com.

Benefits

Some other great things about working at Sleek…

Humility and kindness: Humility is a core attribute we hire for, which means we have a culture of not taking ourselves too seriously and being able to laugh. Kindness is also incredibly important. We are committed to creating and nurturing a diverse and inclusive environment.

Flexibility: You’ll be able to work remotely. If you need to start early or start late to cater to your family or other needs, we don’t mind, so long as you get your work done and proactively communicate. You can also work fully remote from anywhere in the world for 1 month each year

Financial benefits: We pay competitive market salaries and provide staff with generous paid time off and holiday schedules. Certain staff at Sleek are also eligible for our employee share ownership plan and can share in the upside of our stellar growth trajectory as we work toward listing on a prominent stock exchange in the Asia Pacific region.

Personal growth: You’ll get a lot of responsibility and autonomy at Sleek - we move at a fast pace so you’ll be making decisions, making mistakes and learning. There’s also a range of internal and external facing training programmes we run. We’re also at the forefront of utilising AI in our space and are developing a regional centre of AI excellence. It is our intention that if you leave Sleek, you leave as a more well-rounded person and professional.

Sleek is also a proudly certified B Corp. Since we started our journey in 2017, we’ve been committed to building Sleek as a force for good. In just over 5 years, we’ve joined a community of industry leaders like Patagonia, Ben & Jerry's, and P&G who are building an inclusive, equitable, and a regenerative economy.

jobs.description:
Job Title: TikTok Shop Manager
Role: Full-Time
Location: Remote
Core Hours: 8am – 2pm PST
Salary Range: $700 - $900

ABOUT THE ROLE

As TikTok Shop Manager, you will be responsible for building our client's TikTok Shop from the ground up and managing it on an ongoing basis. You will handle everything from initial account registration and product catalog setup through to daily order operations, ad campaign management, affiliate program oversight, and monthly performance reporting. The ideal candidate has operated a high-volume TikTok Shop end-to-end and is comfortable navigating the full Seller Center toolkit.

PHASE 1 RESPONSIBILITIES — SHOP SETUP & CONFIGURATION

Shop Profile & Branding

  • Configure shop name, logo, banner imagery, categories, and storefront layout in Seller Center
  • Write a compelling, keyword-rich shop bio and description
  • Link the TikTok Business/Marketing Account(s) to the shop to enable shoppable video and product tagging

Product Catalog Setup

  • Audit the product range against TikTok's prohibited and restricted product policies and advise the client
  • List products individually or via bulk upload / Shopify catalog sync
  • Optimize product titles with niche search keywords, write detailed descriptions, and upload multi-angle imagery and demo videos
  • Understand and discuss with the client (and then implement) the optimal configuration for SKUs, variants, and pricing; set opening inventory levels
  • Submit all listings for TikTok product approval review and resolve any rejections
  • Conduct a test purchase to validate the full checkout and fulfillment flow

FBM and FBT Configuration

  • Configure FBM: Set warehouse / pickup and return addresses; create shipping templates covering rates, zones, and carrier selection
  • Configure FBT: enroll products, prepare inbound shipments to TikTok warehouses, and configure the free-shipping opt-in settings
  • If using Shopify: install and configure the TikTok channel app to enable real-time inventory and order sync
  • Author and publish the shop's return policy in compliance with applicable consumer protection laws
  • Draft 3PL to FBT ongoing inventory management plan and workflow.

Customer Service

  • Configure customer service notifications
  • Set up FAQs, saved responses, and response workflows
  • Establish return, refund, and cancellation handling procedures
  • Set escalation path for customer support issues

Advertising & Promotions Setup

  • Link TikTok Ads Manager to the shop and configure the primary ad account
  • Launch initial GMV Max campaign(s) — set target ROI, daily budget, and product selection
  • Set up TikTok Search Ads with relevant keyword targeting to capture intent-driven discovery
  • Configure TikTok Pixel if driving traffic to an external website or landing page
  • Build out and maintain welcome promotions, platform coupons, and launch discount strategies in Seller Center

Affiliate / Creator Program Setup

  • Enable and configure the Affiliate Center, including open and targeted collaboration plans
  • Work with our Affiliate/Creator team to set baseline and tiered commission structures across product categories
  • Work with our Affiliate/Creator team to establish a product seeding / free sample program and write a creator brief with content guidelines

PHASE 2 RESPONSIBILITIES — ONGOING MANAGEMENT & OPERATIONS

Daily Operations

  • Monitor and respond to all buyer messages within 12 hours
  • Verify the processing and fulfillment of new orders
  • Review and action open return and refund requests in line with shop policy
  • Monitor product and video comments for customer questions, complaints, or escalations
  • Check the Shop Health dashboard daily for violations, warnings, or Late Dispatch Rate (LDR) increases

Weekly Operations

  • Review GMV Max campaign performance (cost, orders, CPA, ROI) and adjust target ROI as needed
  • Audit GMV Max creative assets and exclude under-performing videos
  • Review inventory levels and initiate restock for SKUs approaching low thresholds
  • Sync inventory counts across all sales channels to prevent overselling
  • Review Search Ads keyword performance and refine bids and match types
  • Monitor and respond to product reviews; flag patterns requiring action
  • Update product listings as needed: pricing, imagery, descriptions, or promotional badges

Monthly Operations

  • Produce a full performance report covering GMV, orders, ad spend, ROAS, and affiliate ROI
  • Export raw order data and build a net revenue / P&L analysis — accounting for referral fees, transaction fees, affiliate commissions, and fulfillment costs
  • Reconcile payouts against Seller Center invoices
  • Review TikTok's ACE Powered Insights for platform-generated growth recommendations
  • Analyze SKU-level performance and identify top and bottom performers
  • Plan and schedule upcoming promotions, flash sales, and seasonal campaigns
  • Work with our Affiliate/Creator Team to review and adjust affiliate commission rates; roll out performance bonuses for top creators
  • Review FBT warehouse inventory and plan replenishment inbound shipments
  • Conduct a shop health audit covering seller score, policy compliance, and LDR trends
  • Monitor TikTok platform policy updates, fee changes, and new ad format rollouts

Quarterly / Strategic Operations

  • Set and document measurable growth goals for the upcoming quarter in collaboration with stakeholders
  • Evaluate catalog expansion opportunities: new SKUs, product bundles, or virtual bundles
  • Review and optimize the fulfillment strategy mix (FBT vs. seller-ship vs. 3PL)
  • Audit the full technology and integration stack: inventory sync tools, shipping apps, analytics platforms
  • Evaluate eligibility for premium seller tiers including Star Shop and Mall status

Crisis & Issue Management

  • Triage and respond to Shop Health violations — pause campaigns and slow order intake if LDR spikes
  • Conduct root cause analysis for fulfillment failures or policy incidents and implement corrective action
  • File TikTok support tickets with supporting documentation when external factors are responsible
  • Manage chargebacks, fraud disputes, and escalated return or refund claims

REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & SKILLS

Platform & Technical

  • Proven hands-on experience managing a TikTok Shop end-to-end via Seller Center — from initial registration through to active daily management
  • Deep familiarity with TikTok Shop Ads — specifically GMV Max campaign setup, optimization, and creative management
  • Working knowledge of Fulfilled by TikTok (FBT): inbound shipping, warehouse management, and fee structures
  • Experience with TikTok Shop's affiliate and creator program: collaboration setup, commission structures, and creator relationship management
  • Proficiency with TikTok Seller Center tools: Shop Health dashboard, ACE Powered Insights, order management, and promotions
  • Experience integrating TikTok Shop with Shopify or other e-commerce platforms for catalog and inventory sync
  • Familiarity with TikTok Search Ads and keyword-based campaign strategy

Operations & Analytics

  • Strong understanding of TikTok Shop's fee structure — referral fees, transaction fees, FBT costs, affiliate commissions, and refund admin fees
  • Ability to build and interpret P&L analyses and net revenue reports from raw Seller Center order data
  • Experience managing customer service operations within a 12-hour response SLA
  • Comfortable managing inventory across multiple fulfillment channels and preventing overselling

Soft Skills & Working Style

  • Highly organized and process-driven — able to manage multiple daily, weekly, and monthly operational rhythms simultaneously
  • Proactive communicator — surfaces issues, opportunities, and insights to stakeholders without prompting
  • Comfortable working in a fast-moving platform environment where policies and features change frequently
  • Detail-oriented with a strong compliance mindset around TikTok's evolving seller policies

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • In the first 30 days: The shop is fully configured, the product catalog is live and approved, fulfillment is operational, the GMV Max campaign is running, and the affiliate program is open for creator applications.
  • By 90 days: The shop has an active roster of affiliate creators generating content, ad campaigns have been optimized based on real performance data, and a regular reporting cadence is in place.
  • Ongoing: The shop maintains a healthy seller score, a sub-12-hour message response rate, and a consistent upward GMV trend quarter-over-quarter.

About the role

Our Cyber Threat Intelligence & Response (CTIR) engineers are the people we count on when something goes wrong, and the people who make sure it goes wrong far less often. This is a hands-on incident response role. You'll lead the response to security events across our platforms and applications: triage, investigate, contain, eradicate and recover, then make sure we come out of it stronger.

We're looking for someone who genuinely loves incident response. Someone who gets calmer and sharper when an incident kicks off, who is confident making decisions when the picture isn't complete, and who doesn't wait to be told what to look at. If you're a self-starter who takes ownership from the first alert to the final report, you'll fit right in.

Location: Remote

Reports to: VP of Cybersecurity | Cyber Threat Intelligence, Engineering & Response

What you'll do

  • Own incidents as part of the CTIR team: detect, triage, investigate, contain and eradicate, driving each one until the threat is under control.
  • Work live incidents alongside the team and be ready to step up and take the lead yourself when the situation calls for it.
  • Lead investigations across our systems, digging into logs, endpoints, email and network data to work out what happened, how far it reached, and how to resolve.
  • Perform host and network forensics, malware triage, and email analysis (including PDF and document analysis) to understand attacker activity and build a reliable timeline.
  • Coordinate with engineering, IT and the wider security team during a response, and communicate clearly to both technical teams and leadership.
  • Hunt proactively for threats across system logs, user behaviour and threat intelligence, turning what you find into new detections and indicators of compromise.
  • Build and automate incident response workflows and playbooks so routine response is fast and repeatable.
  • Strengthen our detection coverage using the MITRE ATT&CK framework, closing monitoring gaps, and tuning to reduce noise.
  • Feed what you learn from each incident back into how the team detects and responds, so an attack pattern we've seen once is caught faster next time.
  • Analyse threat intelligence, research emerging threats, and recommend practical mitigation.
  • Be ready to work incidents as they arise, including on-call and out-of-hours cover when needed.

What we're looking for

People who want to make a real difference in security, and who care about incident response in particular.

  • 3 to 6 years experience in security operations or incident response, with genuine passion for running incidents, not just watching a queue.
  • Confidence managing incidents through the full incident-handling lifecycle, and the judgement to make sound calls under pressure.
  • Strong triage and root cause analysis, with a solid understanding of different log sources and how to correlate events across them.
  • Comfortable reading logs (HTTP, SMTP, network), Windows and Active Directory, and common operating systems and servers.
  • Hands-on experience with a SIEM to investigate, hunt and build detections. Microsoft Sentinel and KQL preferred.
  • Practical experience across EDR, advanced threat protection, identity management and API security.
  • Threat-hunting experience across network flow, user behaviour and threat intelligence, plus the ability to design new ways to detect and contain attacks using scripting, analytics and automation.
  • Familiar with a broad range of attacker tools and techniques (TTPs), with the ability to map adversary activity across the Cyber Kill Chain to identify, assess, and communicate potential attack progression.
  • A self-starter who works independently, delivering projects without being chased, and keeps learning as the industry develops.
  • A critical thinker with strong problem-solving instincts and exceptional communication skills, capable of translating complex technical risks into clear, actionable insights for both the immediate team and cross-functional partners, including engineers, administrators, and leadership, through both verbal and written communication.
  • Good understanding of ITIL processes and standards such as ISO 27001 and PCI DSS, including change, incident and problem management.

Nice to have

  • Malware analysis experience.
  • Preferred certifications such as GCIH, GCFA, AZ-500 or SC-100.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Cybersecurity Engineer is responsible for independently executing defined security engineering and operational work across Accela’s endpoints, identities, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems. This role applies established security standards and practices to troubleshoot issues, maintain technical controls, analyze findings, implement solutions, and identify opportunities to improve how the team operates.

The Cybersecurity Engineer partners with IT, Engineering, DevOps, IAM, Compliance, and other teams to maintain effective technical safeguards while supporting business continuity. The role is expected to independently manage routine and moderately complex work, make sound decisions within established practices, and escalate highly complex or unfamiliar matters to senior engineers or security leadership as appropriate.

The ideal candidate brings strong enterprise IT experience, hands-on exposure to security technologies, and the ability to take ownership of assigned work from identification through resolution. This individual is also expected to identify recurring issues, recommend process or automation improvements, and continue building technical depth across security tooling, cloud platforms, and enterprise systems.

SPECIFIC RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Independently manage endpoint security and compliance activities across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments, including security baselines, EDR and antivirus agents, disk encryption, MDM, and operating system hardening.
  • Administer and troubleshoot identity and access controls, including account provisioning and deprovisioning, SSO, MFA, conditional access, and authentication issues.
  • Monitor and analyze alerts and logs within SIEM, EDR, and related platforms, perform initial triage, take appropriate action within established procedures, and escalate complex findings when necessary.
  • Conduct initial technical investigations by gathering and analyzing evidence, documenting findings, and recommending appropriate next steps.
  • Manage assigned vulnerability-management activities, including reviewing scan results, evaluating severity and exploitability, coordinating remediation with system owners, and tracking work through completion.
  • Perform periodic access reviews, recertification activities, privileged-access reviews, and third-party access validation to support least-privilege practices.
  • Own defined workstreams within security technology implementations, including planning, testing, configuration, pilot deployments, documentation, and rollout support.
  • Maintain assigned technical controls and support evidence collection and control activities associated with SOC 2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and other applicable frameworks.
  • Develop and maintain scripts or automation using tools such as PowerShell, Bash, or Python to reduce manual effort and improve operational consistency.
  • Independently troubleshoot routine and moderately complex technical issues and coordinate with appropriate teams to drive issues through resolution.

  • Identify recurring operational issues and recommend improvements to processes, tooling, configurations, automation, or documentation.

  • Use operational data and technical findings to identify trends and recommend improvements to security practices and processes.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of team workflows by identifying opportunities to simplify work, improve consistency, and reduce repetitive manual activities.
  • Maintain current knowledge of evolving security technologies, cloud platforms, industry practices, and emerging technical threats.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise IT, endpoint operations, identity and access management, security operations, systems administration, or a related technical field.
  • Hands-on experience maintaining and troubleshooting endpoint technologies across Windows, macOS, and Linux, including EDR or antivirus agents, MDM, disk encryption, and operating system configurations.
  • Working knowledge of identity and access management technologies and practices, including Active Directory, SSO, MFA, conditional access, and account lifecycle management.
  • Experience reviewing technical logs, troubleshooting alerts, conducting initial investigations, or supporting vulnerability-management activities.
  • Experience working with enterprise platforms such as Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, or similar SaaS environments and understanding their identity and access models.
  • Experience using PowerShell, Bash, Python, or similar scripting and command-line tools for troubleshooting or automating routine tasks.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage assigned technical work, determine appropriate next steps, and escalate when issues exceed established scope or expertise.
  • Ability to identify recurring issues and recommend practical improvements to tools, workflows, documentation, or technical processes.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate technical information and make sound decisions.
  • Strong documentation skills, including experience creating and maintaining runbooks, workflows, technical procedures, or knowledge resources.
  • Ability to balance technical requirements with operational and business needs.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across technical and business teams.

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS
